V10-M03-CA-016例3：研究独立性与公司内部压力
Example 3: Research Independence and Intrafirm Pressure

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 80

题目与资料 / Question and data

例3：研究独立性与公司内部压力 Example 3: Research Independence and Intrafirm Pressure

Fritz是Hilton Brokerage负责矿业的股票分析师。

Fritz is an equity analyst at Hilton Brokerage who covers the mining industry.

他认为Metals & Mining的当前股价过高，但担心负面研究报告会损害该公司与自己公司投资银行部门之间的良好关系。

He has concluded that the stock of Metals & Mining is overpriced at its current level, but he is concerned that a negative research report will hurt the good relationship between Metals & Mining and the investment banking division of his firm.

事实上，Hilton Brokerage的一位高级管理人员刚给他发了一份建议书副本，内容是公司建议为Metals & Mining承销债券发行。

In fact, a senior manager of Hilton Brokerage just sent him a copy of a proposal his firm made to Metals & Mining to underwrite a debt offering.

Fritz需要立即出具报告，却对给出不够正面的评级感到担忧。

Fritz needs to produce a report right away and is concerned about issuing a less-than-favorable rating.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Fritz对Metals & Mining的分析必须客观，且只能依据公司基本面。

Comment: Fritz’s analysis of Metals & Mining must be objective and based solely on consideration of company fundamentals.

来自本公司其他部门的任何压力都是不当的。

Any pressure from other divisions of his firm is inappropriate.

如果Hilton Brokerage预先考虑到此次发行，并把Metals & Mining列入限制名单，这种冲突就可以消除。

This conflict could have been eliminated if, in anticipation of the offering, Hilton Brokerage had placed Metals & Mining on a restricted list.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例3：研究独立性与公司内部压力”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

内部压力并不会改变分析师的专业责任。即便业务同事、主管或发行人希望维持评级，也应回到证据和估值；如无法诚实发表判断，应向合规升级或退出相关任务，而不是给出明知不合理的意见。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

为什么容易选错：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

例4：研究独立性与发行人关系压力 Example 4: Research Independence and Issuer Relationship Pressure

Fritz是Hilton Brokerage负责矿业的股票分析师。

Fritz is an equity analyst at Hilton Brokerage who covers the mining industry.

Fritz认为Metals & Mining当前股价被高估，但担心负面研究报告可能危及自己多年来与该公司首席执行官、首席财务官及投资者关系负责人建立的密切关系。

Fritz has concluded that Metals & Mining stock is overvalued at its current level, but he is concerned that a negative research report might jeopardize a close rapport that he has nurtured over the years with Metals & Mining’s CEO, chief financial officer, and investment relations officer.

Fritz还担心负面报告引发管理层报复，例如不让他参加季度业绩发布电话会议、不允许他在会上提问，和／或拒绝他接触高层管理人员，以致无法安排Hilton Brokerage客户与Metals & Mining高层的团体会面。

Fritz is concerned that a negative report might also result in management retaliation—for instance, cutting him off from participating in conference calls when a quarterly earnings release is made, denying him the ability to ask questions on such calls, and/or denying him access to top management for arranging group meetings between Hilton Brokerage clients and top Metals & Mining managers.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Fritz的分析必须客观，且只能依据公司基本面。

Comment: Fritz’s analysis must be objective and based solely on consideration of company fundamentals.

Metals & Mining施加的任何压力都是不当的。为证明结论的诚信，Fritz应完整记录其工作，包括投资建议如何基于相对估值得出。

Any pressure from Metals & Mining is inappropriate. To support the integrity of his conclusions, Fritz should fully document his work, including how his investment recommendation is based on relative valuation.

V10-M03-CA-018例5：研究独立性与销售压力
Example 5: Research Independence and Sales Pressure

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 81

题目与资料 / Question and data

例5：研究独立性与销售压力 Example 5: Research Independence and Sales Pressure

Warner的工作是支持公司债部门的销售活动，为固定收益投资者提供信用方面的指引。

In her role supporting the sales effort of a corporate bond department, Warner offers credit guidance to fixed-income investors.

她的报酬与公司债部门的业绩密切相关。

Her compensation is closely linked to the performance of the corporate bond department.

临近季度末，Warner所在公司持有大量Milton, Ltd.债券库存，但因Milton最近宣布出现经营问题，这些债券一直卖不出去。

Near the quarter’s end, Warner’s firm has a large inventory position in the bonds of Milton, Ltd., and has been unable to sell the bonds because of Milton’s recent announcement of an operating problem.

销售人员要求她联系大客户，推销这些债券。

Salespeople have asked her to contact large clients to push the bonds.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：不道德的销售做法很可能造成严重违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》的问题。

Comment: Unethical sales practices create significant potential violations of the Code and Standards.

Warner对Milton债券的看法，不得受到内部压力或报酬的影响。

Warner’s opinion of the Milton bonds must not be affected by internal pressure or compensation.

本例中，Warner必须拒绝推销Milton债券，除非她能合理证明市场价格已反映该经营问题。

In this case, Warner must refuse to push the Milton bonds unless she is able to justify that the market price has already adjusted for the operating problem.

V10-M03-CA-019例6：研究独立性与此前研究覆盖
Example 6: Research Independence and Prior Coverage

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 81

题目与资料 / Question and data

例6：研究独立性与此前研究覆盖 Example 6: Research Independence and Prior Coverage

Jorund是一位研究航空股票的证券分析师，也是公司的新星。

Jorund, a securities analyst following airline stocks, is a rising star at her firm.

她的上司一直给予International Airlines“买入”建议，并要求Jorund接手该航空公司的研究覆盖。

Her boss has been carrying a “buy” recommendation on International Airlines and asks Jorund to take over coverage of the airline.

上司告诉Jorund，无论如何都不得更改现有买入建议。

He tells Jorund that under no circumstances should the prevailing buy recommendation be changed.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Jorund对International Airlines的分析必须独立、客观。

Comment: Jorund must be independent and objective in her analysis of International Airlines.

如果她认为上司的指示损害了自己的独立判断，有两种选择：告诉上司，自己无法在这些限制下覆盖该公司；或者接手研究，形成独立结论，若与上司意见冲突，则向上司或公司其他主管说明结论，以便他们提出适当建议。

If she believes that her boss’s instructions have compromised her, she has two options: She can tell her boss that she cannot cover the company under these constraints, or she can take over coverage of the company, reach her own independent conclusions, and if they conflict with her boss’s opinion, share the conclusions with her boss or other supervisors in the firm so that they can make appropriate recommendations.

Jorund只能发布反映其独立、客观意见的建议。

Jorund must issue only recommendations that reflect her independent and objective opinion.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例6：研究独立性与此前研究覆盖”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

V10-M03-CA-020例7：关联方的礼物和招待
Example 7: Gifts and Entertainment from Related Parties

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 81

题目与资料 / Question and data

例7：关联方的礼物和招待 Example 7: Gifts and Entertainment from Related Parties

Grant把大量佣金业务交给一家位于纽约的经纪公司。

Grant directs a large amount of his commission business to a New York–based brokerage house.

为感谢这些业务，该经纪公司赠送Grant两张南非世界杯门票、附近度假村两晚住宿、数次餐饮，以及乘坐豪华轿车前往赛场的接送服务。

In appreciation for all the business, the brokerage house gives Grant two tickets to the World Cup in South Africa, two nights at a nearby resort, several meals, and transportation via limousine to the game.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Grant违反了准则I(B)，因为接受这些价值丰厚的礼物可能妨碍其独立性与客观性。

Comment: Grant violated Standard I(B) because accepting these substantial gifts may impede his independence and objectivity.

会员与考生不得索取或接受会影响其独立性与客观性，或可合理预期会影响其决策过程的礼物、捐款或其他报酬。

Members and candidates must not solicit or accept gifts, contributions, or other compensation that affects their independence and objectivity or that reasonably could be expected to influence their decision-making process.

最佳做法是避免那些在提出投资建议或采取投资行动时，可能导致或被认为会导致失去独立性或客观性的情境。

Best practice is to avoid situations that might cause or be perceived to cause a loss of independence or objectivity in recommending investments or taking investment action.

Grant接受这次旅行，造成了利益冲突，也使自己面临为回报经纪商而给予其优待的指责。

By accepting the trip, Grant created a conflict of interest and opened himself up to the accusation that he may give the broker favored treatment in return.

Grant至少必须向雇主和客户披露这一冲突。

At a minimum, Grant must disclose this conflict to his employer and clients.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例7：关联方的礼物和招待”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

礼品和关系往来应按接受者的决策角色评估。如果提供好处的人正在争取交易、经理遴选或业务，合理观察者可能怀疑判断被影响；应审查好处的价值、频率、时点与独立审批。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

为什么容易选错：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(B) — 独立性与客观性 / Independence and Objectivity

相关边界：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

V10-M03-CA-021例8：客户的礼物和招待
Example 8: Gifts and Entertainment from Clients

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 82

题目与资料 / Question and data

例8：客户的礼物和招待 Example 8: Gifts and Entertainment from Clients

Green为Tisbury Investments的客户Knowlden管理投资组合。

Green manages the portfolio of Knowlden, a client of Tisbury Investments.

Green为Knowlden取得的年度回报，一直高于双方此前约定的基准。

Green achieves an annual return for Knowlden that is consistently better than that of the benchmark she and the client previously agreed to.

作为奖励，Knowlden赠送Green两张温布尔登网球锦标赛门票，并让她在自己的伦敦公寓免费住一周。

As a reward, Knowlden offers Green two tickets to Wimbledon and the use of Knowlden’s flat in London for a week.

Green向Tisbury的上司披露了这份礼物。

Green discloses this gift to her supervisor at Tisbury.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Green符合准则I(B)，因为她披露了其中一位客户赠送的礼物。

Comment: Green is in compliance with Standard I(B) because she disclosed the gift from one of her clients.

会员与考生只要向雇主披露，就可以接受客户的奖金或礼物，因为客户关系中的礼物被认为比其他情形下的礼物较不容易影响其客观性与独立性。

Members and candidates may accept bonuses or gifts from clients as long as they disclose them to their employer because gifts in a client relationship are deemed less likely to affect a member’s or candidate’s objectivity and independence than gifts in other situations.

但仍必须披露，以便主管监督这些情况，防止员工偏袒送礼客户而损害其他付费客户，例如把更高比例的IPO股票分配给送礼客户的投资组合。

Disclosure is required, however, so that supervisors can monitor such situations to guard against employees favoring a gift-giving client to the detriment of other fee-paying clients (such as by allocating a greater proportion of IPO stock to the gift-giving client’s portfolio).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例8：客户的礼物和招待”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

把“对过去服务的感谢”与“为未来表现设定报酬”分开。前者仍需按政策向雇主披露，后者会改变未来激励并触及额外报酬的事前书面同意要求，不能用一次简单披露替代所有条件。

礼品和关系往来应按接受者的决策角色评估。如果提供好处的人正在争取交易、经理遴选或业务，合理观察者可能怀疑判断被影响；应审查好处的价值、频率、时点与独立审批。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

为什么容易选错：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(B) — 独立性与客观性 / Independence and Objectivity

相关边界：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

V10-M03-CA-022例9：外部经理承担差旅费用
Example 9: Travel Expenses from External Managers

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 82

题目与资料 / Question and data

例9：外部经理承担差旅费用 Example 9: Travel Expenses from External Managers

Wayne是Franklin市雇员养老金计划的投资经理。

Wayne is the investment manager of the Franklin City Employee Pension Plan.

他最近成功完成了寻找公司管理该计划多元化投资组合中海外股票部分的工作。

He recently completed a successful search for a firm to manage the foreign equity allocation of the plan’s diversified portfolio.

他遵循计划的标准程序，邀请多家具备资格的公司作介绍，并基于Penguin Advisers的经验、明确的投资策略和业绩记录，建议董事会选用该公司。

He followed the plan’s standard procedure of seeking presentations from a number of qualified firms and recommended that his board select Penguin Advisers because of its experience, well-defined investment strategy, and performance record.

该公司宣称遵守全球投资业绩标准（GIPS®），且已接受验证。

The firm claims compliance with the Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS®) and has been verified.

选定Penguin后，《Franklin City Record》的一名记者打电话询问：这一决定是否与Wayne年初参加的“亚洲投资考察之旅”有关，因为Penguin Advisers正是该行程的赞助方之一。

Following the selection of Penguin, a reporter from the Franklin City Record calls to ask whether there was any connection between this action and the fact that Penguin Advisers was one of the sponsors of an “investment fact-finding trip to Asia” that Wayne made earlier in the year.

这次旅行是Pension Investment Academy举办的多次考察之一；该机构安排团队在多个亚洲国家的主要城市，与经济界、政府及企业负责人会面。

The trip was one of several conducted by the Pension Investment Academy, which had arranged the itinerary of meetings with economic, government, and corporate officials in major cities in several Asian countries.

Pension Investment Academy从包括Penguin Advisers在内的多家投资管理机构获得旅行费用资助，再为参加行程的各养老金计划经理支付差旅费用，并提供所有餐饮和住宿。

The Pension Investment Academy obtains support for the cost of these trips from a number of investment managers, including Penguin Advisers; the Academy then pays the travel expenses of the various pension plan managers on the trip and provides all meals and accommodations.

Penguin Advisers的总裁也是同行者之一。

The president of Penguin Advisers was also one of the travelers on the trip.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Wayne在选择外部投资组合经理及管理养老金计划的其他方面，或许可以充分运用旅途中获得的知识；但他参加了部分由Penguin Advisers付费的国际旅行，又每天与其总裁同行，因此可能形成利益冲突，使推荐Penguin Advisers的决定受到质疑。

Comment: Although Wayne can probably put to good use the knowledge he gained from the trip when selecting external portfolio managers and in other areas of managing the pension plan, his recommendation of Penguin Advisers may be tainted by the possible conflict incurred when he participated in the international trip partly paid for by Penguin Advisers and when he was in the daily company of the president of Penguin Advisers.

为避免违反准则I(B)，Wayne的基本交通和住宿费用应由雇主或养老金计划支付；与Penguin Advisers总裁的接触应仅限于信息交流或教育活动；旅行本身、组织者和赞助方也应公开记录。

To avoid violating Standard I(B), Wayne’s basic expenses for travel and accommodations should have been paid by his employer or the pension plan; contact with the president of Penguin Advisers should have been limited to informational or educational events only; and the trip, the organizer, and the sponsor should have been made a matter of public record.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例9：外部经理承担差旅费用”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

旅行费用要看必要性、合理性和利益来源。偏远现场调研所需的普通交通与豪华度假招待具有不同的独立性影响；能由自己或雇主负担时，直接支付通常更容易避免利益牵连。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

为什么容易选错：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(B) — 独立性与客观性 / Independence and Objectivity

V10-M03-CA-023例10：研究独立性与报酬安排
Example 10: Research Independence and Compensation Arrangements

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 83

题目与资料 / Question and data

例10：研究独立性与报酬安排 Example 10: Research Independence and Compensation Arrangements

Herrero最近离开了一家大型投资顾问公司的研究分析师岗位。

Herrero recently left his job as a research analyst for a large investment adviser.

在寻找新工作期间，一家投资者关系公司以承包形式聘请他，为该公司的一位客户——一家小型教育软件公司——撰写研究报告。

While looking for a new position, he was hired as a contractor by an investor relations firm to write a research report on one of its clients, a small educational software company.

这家投资者关系公司希望激发投资者对该科技公司的兴趣。

The investor relations firm hopes to generate investor interest in the technology company.

公司将向Herrero支付固定费用；如果有新投资者因其报告而购买该公司股票，还会额外支付奖金。

The firm will pay Herrero a flat fee plus a bonus if any new investors buy stock in the company as a result of Herrero’s report.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：如果Herrero接受这种付款安排，就会违反准则I(B)，因为可以合理预期该报酬安排将损害其独立性与客观性。

Comment: If Herrero accepts this payment arrangement, he will be in violation of Standard I(B) because the compensation arrangement can reasonably be expected to compromise his independence and objectivity.

Herrero将因吸引投资者而获得奖金，这会使他有动机不顾事实地撰写正面报告，并忽略或淡化公司的负面信息。

Herrero will receive a bonus for attracting investors, which provides an incentive to draft a positive report regardless of the facts and to ignore or play down any negative information about the company.

Herrero只应接受不与报告结论或建议挂钩的固定费用。

Herrero should accept only a flat fee that is not tied to the conclusions or recommendations of the report.

在某些情况下，只要分析师采取措施保持客观性，并在报告中恰当披露潜在利益冲突，客观、无偏的发行人付费研究是可以接受的。

Issuer-paid research that is objective and unbiased is acceptable under certain circumstances as long as the analyst takes steps to maintain his or her objectivity and includes in the report proper disclosures regarding potential conflicts of interest.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例10：研究独立性与报酬安排”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

发行人付费研究必须让读者知道谁付钱及如何付钱。固定、与结论或销售无关的收费方式更有利于保持客观；报酬与报告结论、股价或融资成功挂钩会产生更直接的诱导。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

为什么容易选错：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

V10-M03-CA-024例11：影响经理甄选决定
Example 11: Influencing Manager Selection Decisions

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 83

题目与资料 / Question and data

例11：影响经理甄选决定 Example 11: Influencing Manager Selection Decisions

Mandel是ZZYY Capital Management的高级投资组合经理，领导一支管理工会养老金的投资专业团队。

Mandel is a senior portfolio manager for ZZYY Capital Management who oversees a team of investment professionals who manage labor union pension funds.

几年前，ZZYY参加了一项竞争性资产管理人遴选，争取管理United Doughnut and Pretzel Bakers Union（UDPBU）养老金中的大额资产配置。

A few years ago, ZZYY sought to win a competitive asset manager search to manage a significant allocation of the pension fund of the United Doughnut and Pretzel Bakers Union (UDPBU).

UDPBU投资委员会的主席Gomez是一位公认的重要决策者，也是工会的长期领导人。

UDPBU’s investment board is chaired by Gomez, a recognized key decision maker and long-time leader of the union.

为提高ZZYY胜出的机会，Mandel向Gomez的工会连任竞选基金捐赠了大笔金钱。

To improve ZZYY’s chances of winning the competition, Mandel made significant monetary contributions to Gomez’s union reelection campaign fund.

即使ZZYY已被聘为养老金的主要管理人之一，Mandel仍觉得公司的地位不稳固。

Even after ZZYY was hired as a primary manager of the pension fund, Mandel believed that his firm’s position was not secure.

Mandel继续向Gomez的连任竞选基金捐款，并经常在顶级餐厅豪华招待这位工会领导人及其家人。

Mandel continued to contribute to Gomez’s reelection campaign fund and lavishly entertained the union leader and his family at top restaurants on a regular basis.

Mandel的所有支出都按惯例列作营销费用，通过ZZYY的费用账户报销；他向高层管理者披露，这些支出有助于与重要客户保持牢固而密切的关系。

All of Mandel’s outlays were routinely handled as marketing expenses reimbursed by ZZYY’s expense accounts and were disclosed to his senior management as being instrumental in maintaining a strong close relationship with an important client.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Mandel不仅提出，而且实际提供了金钱礼物、利益和其他对价，可以合理预期这些安排会损害Gomez的客观性。

Comment: Mandel not only offered but actually gave monetary gifts, benefits, and other considerations that reasonably could be expected to compromise Gomez’s objectivity.

因此，Mandel违反了准则I(B)。

Therefore, Mandel was in violation of Standard I(B).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例11：影响经理甄选决定”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

礼品和关系往来应按接受者的决策角色评估。如果提供好处的人正在争取交易、经理遴选或业务，合理观察者可能怀疑判断被影响；应审查好处的价值、频率、时点与独立审批。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

V10-M03-CA-025例12：基金经理关系
Example 12: Fund Manager Relationships

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 83-84

题目与资料 / Question and data

例12：基金经理关系 Example 12: Fund Manager Relationships

Scott是一位业绩分析师，负责为公司分析外部经理的业绩。

Scott is a performance analyst who is responsible for analyzing the performance of external managers for her firm.

在完成季度分析时，Scott注意到某位经理报告的组合构建方式发生变化。

While completing her quarterly analysis, Scott notices a change in one manager’s reported composite construction.

该变更把一个规模特别大的账户放入新的剩余账户组合，从而掩盖其糟糕表现。

The change concealed the bad performance of a particularly large account by placing that account into a new residual composite.

这一调整使该经理继续位居经理业绩排名前列。

This change allowed the manager to remain at the top of the list of manager performance.

Scott知道，公司向这位经理配置了大量资金，而且该基金经理是首席执行官的密友。

Scott knows her firm has a large allocation to this manager, and the fund’s manager is a close personal friend of the CEO.

她需要提交最终报告，却对指出组合变更感到担忧。

She needs to deliver her final report but is concerned about pointing out the composite change.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：如果Scott未在最终报告中披露这一变更，就会违反准则I(B)。

Comment: Scott would be in violation of Standard I(B) if she did not disclose the change in her final report.

对经理业绩的分析，不得受到私人关系或向外部经理配置资金规模的影响。

The analysis of managers’ performance must not be influenced by personal relationships or the size of the allocation to the outside managers.

如果Scott不纳入这一变更，就没有为公司提供关于业绩指标的独立分析。

By not including the change, Scott would not be providing an independent analysis of the performance metrics for her firm.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例12：基金经理关系”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

V10-M03-CA-026例13：公司内部压力
Example 13: Intrafirm Pressure

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 84

题目与资料 / Question and data

例13：公司内部压力 Example 13: Intrafirm Pressure

Stein是公司的业绩衡量负责人。上一季度，由于投资建议质量较差，公司研究部门的许多员工被解聘。

Stein is head of performance measurement for her firm. During the last quarter, many members of the organization’s research department were removed because of the poor quality of their recommendations.

低质量研究使一位大额账户客户的业绩显著落后，导致其在季度结束后撤走资金。

The subpar research caused one larger account holder to experience significant underperformance, which resulted in the client withdrawing his money after the end of the quarter.

销售主管要求Stein将该账户从公司的业绩组合中移除，理由是业绩下滑应归咎于已离职的研究团队，而不是客户顾问。

The head of sales requests that Stein remove this account from the firm’s performance composite because the performance decline can be attributed to the departed research team and not the client’s adviser.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：来自公司其他内部部门的压力，可能造成使会员或考生违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》的情境。

Comment: Pressure from other internal departments can create situations that cause a member or candidate to violate the Code and Standards.

Stein必须保持独立性与客观性，并拒绝将特定账户从其本应归属的公司业绩组合中剔除。

Stein must maintain her independence and objectivity and refuse to exclude specific accounts from the firm’s performance composites to which they belong.

只要客户的投资策略与该已定义组合的策略相似，就不能因为选股不佳导致业绩落后和资金撤出，而将其排除。

As long as the client invested under a strategy similar to that of the defined composite, it cannot be excluded because of the poor stock selections that led to the underperformance and asset withdrawal.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例13：公司内部压力”应放在准则 I(B) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：判断礼品、旅行、报酬或内部压力是否可能影响专业判断，或使合理观察者怀疑判断受到影响。研究意见必须以独立分析为基础，不能服从销售目标、投行业务或发行人的偏好。

内部压力并不会改变分析师的专业责任。即便业务同事、主管或发行人希望维持评级，也应回到证据和估值；如无法诚实发表判断，应向合规升级或退出相关任务，而不是给出明知不合理的意见。

推理顺序：看利益由谁提供、价值和频率如何、是否与未来表现挂钩，以及是否有合理业务目的。必要时拒收、由自己或雇主支付费用，并作恰当披露。

为什么容易选错：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(B) — 独立性与客观性 / Independence and Objectivity

相关边界：客户对过去服务表示感谢与外部供应商试图影响选择，风险不同；披露也并不能自动使明显损害独立性的安排变得可接受。

V10-M03-CA-027例1：陈述公司的能力
Example 1: Representing the Firm’s Abilities

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 88-89

题目与资料 / Question and data

例1：陈述公司的能力 Example 1: Representing the Firm’s Abilities

Rogers是小型投资顾问公司Rogers and Black的合伙人。

Rogers is a partner at Rogers and Black, a small firm offering investment advisory services.

她向一位继承了价值100万美元投资组合的潜在客户保证：“我们可以提供您所需的全部金融和投资服务。”

She assures a prospective client who inherited a portfolio worth US$1 million that “we can perform all the financial and investment services you need.”

Rogers and Black有充分能力提供投资建议，但实际上无法提供税务规划等全套金融和投资服务。

Rogers and Black is well equipped to provide investment advice but, in fact, cannot provide a full array of financial and investment services, such as tax planning.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：Rogers以口头方式歪曲了公司能够向潜在客户提供的服务，违反准则I(C)。

Comment: Rogers violated Standard I(C) by orally misrepresenting the services her firm can perform for the prospective client.

使用“您所需的全部金融和投资服务”这类模糊、不精确、笼统的措辞，过度吹嘘并歪曲了她本人及公司能够提供的服务。

Using vague, imprecise, and general language such as “all the financial and investment services you need” oversells and misrepresents the services she and her firm can provide.

她必须仅描述Rogers and Black能够提供的投资顾问服务范围，并表示愿意协助客户从其他渠道获取公司无法提供的金融和投资服务。

She must limit herself to describing the range of investment advisory services Rogers and Black can provide and offer to help the client obtain elsewhere the financial and investment services that her firm cannot provide.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例1：陈述公司的能力”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(C) — 禁止虚假陈述 / Misrepresentation

相关边界：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-028例2：披露发行人付费研究
Example 2: Disclosure of Issuer-Paid Research

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 89

题目与资料 / Question and data

例2：披露发行人付费研究 Example 2: Disclosure of Issuer-Paid Research

McGuire是一位由发行人付费的分析师，受上市公司聘请，通过电子渠道推广其股票。

McGuire is an issuer-paid analyst hired by publicly traded companies to electronically promote their stocks.

McGuire建立了一个网站，将自己的研究工作宣传为看似独立的分析师研究。

McGuire creates a website that promotes his research efforts as a seemingly independent analyst.

他在网站上为每家公司发布简介和“强烈买入”建议，表示预计股价会上涨。

McGuire posts a profile and a strong buy recommendation for each company on the website, indicating that the stock is expected to increase in value.

他没有在网站、所发布的研究报告，或在网络聊天室对这些公司作出的陈述中，披露与研究覆盖公司之间的合约关系。

He does not disclose the contractual relationships with the companies he covers on his website, in the research reports he issues, or in the statements he makes about the companies in internet chatrooms.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：McGuire违反了准则I(C)，因为该网站对潜在投资者具有误导性。

Comment: McGuire violated Standard I(C) because the internet site is misleading to potential investors.

即使建议有效且有充分研究支持，他隐瞒自己与研究对象公司之间的真实关系，也构成虚假陈述。

Even if the recommendations are valid and supported with thorough research, his omissions regarding the true relationship between himself and the companies he covers constitute a misrepresentation.

McGuire没有披露其向这些公司提供服务并收取报酬的安排，因此也违反准则VI(A)“避免或披露利益冲突”。

McGuire also violated Standard VI(A) Avoid or Disclose Conflicts by not disclosing the existence of an arrangement with the companies from which he receives compensation in exchange for his services.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例2：披露发行人付费研究”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

发行人付费研究必须让读者知道谁付钱及如何付钱。固定、与结论或销售无关的收费方式更有利于保持客观；报酬与报告结论、股价或融资成功挂钩会产生更直接的诱导。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(C) — 禁止虚假陈述 / Misrepresentation

相关边界：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-029例3：纠正无意错误
Example 3: Correction of Unintentional Errors

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 89

题目与资料 / Question and data

例3：纠正无意错误 Example 3: Correction of Unintentional Errors

Yao负责制作和分发公司的营销材料，该公司宣称遵守GIPS标准。

Yao is responsible for the creation and distribution of the marketing materials for his firm, which claims compliance with the GIPS standards.

Yao为公司的亚洲股票组合制作并分发了一份业绩展示材料，声称该组合资产为¥350 billion（3,500亿）。

Yao creates and distributes a presentation of performance for the firm’s Asian Equity Composite that states the composite has ¥350 billion in assets.

实际上，该组合资产只有¥35 billion（350亿）；展示材料中的较高数字源于排印错误。

In fact, the composite has only ¥35 billion in assets, and the higher figure on the presentation is a result of a typographical error.

然而，在Yao发现错误之前，错误材料已经分发给多位客户。

Nevertheless, the erroneous material is distributed to a number of clients before Yao catches the mistake.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评述：发现错误后，Yao必须采取措施停止分发错误材料，并通过通知已收到错误信息的人来纠正错误。

Comment: Once the error is discovered, Yao must take steps to cease distribution of the incorrect material and correct the error by informing those who have received the erroneous information.

不过，由于Yao并非明知而作出虚假陈述，他没有违反准则I(C)。

Because Yao did not knowingly make the misrepresentation, however, he did not violate Standard I(C).

由于公司宣称遵守GIPS标准，他也必须遵守GIPS标准关于重大错误处理的要求。

Since his firm claims compliance with the GIPS standards, he must also comply with the GIPS standards requirements addressing the treatment of material errors.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例3：纠正无意错误”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

错误是否最初出于无意，主要影响起因，不改变发现之后的纠正责任。应停止继续分发错误版本、核实正确数据并通知受影响对象；明知不改会让后续陈述持续误导。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-030例4：不纠正已知错误
Example 4: Not Correcting Known Errors

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 89-90

题目与资料 / Question and data

例4：不纠正已知错误 Example 4: Not Correcting Known Errors

Muhammad是一家投资管理公司的总裁。

Muhammad is the president of an investment management firm.

公司营销部门制作的宣传材料错误声称，Muhammad除了持有CFA称号，还拥有一所知名商学院的金融高等学位。

The promotional material for the firm, created by the firm’s marketing department, incorrectly claims that Muhammad has an advanced degree in finance from a prestigious business school in addition to the CFA designation.

虽然Muhammad曾短暂就读该校，但未获得学位。

Although Muhammad attended the school for a short period of time, he did not receive a degree.

多年来，Muhammad及公司其他人员把这份材料分发给了众多潜在客户和顾问。

Over the years, Muhammad and others in the firm have distributed this material to numerous prospective clients and consultants.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：即使 Muhammad 并非公司宣传资料中虚假表述其资历的直接责任人，但由于他在较长时期内多次使用这些资料，理应知晓其中的虚假陈述，因此违反了准则 I(C)。

Comment: Even though Muhammad may not have been directly responsible for the misrepresentation of his credentials in the firm’s promotional material, he should have known of the misrepresentation because he used this material numerous times over an extended period, and therefore, he violated Standard I(C).

Muhammad 一旦发现宣传资料中的错误，就应纠正相关信息。

Once Muhammad became aware of the errors in the promotional material, he should have corrected the information.

最佳做法是，Muhammad 向所有收到错误资料的人提供正确信息。

Best practice would be for Muhammad to provide correct information to any recipients of the erroneous material.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例4：不纠正已知错误”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

错误是否最初出于无意，主要影响起因，不改变发现之后的纠正责任。应停止继续分发错误版本、核实正确数据并通知受影响对象；明知不改会让后续陈述持续误导。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-031例 5：剽窃
Example 5: Plagiarism

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 90

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 5：剽窃 Example 5: Plagiarism

Grant 是一家加拿大证券经纪公司的研究分析师，过去 10 年一直专门研究加拿大采矿业。

Grant, a research analyst for a Canadian brokerage firm, has specialized in the Canadian mining industry for the past 10 years.

她最近读到另一家公司分析师 Barton 撰写的一份关于 Jefferson Mining, Ltd. 的详尽研究报告。

She recently read an extensive research report on Jefferson Mining, Ltd., by Barton, an analyst at a different firm.

Barton 提供了大量统计资料，涉及矿产储量、生产能力、销售速率，以及影响 Jefferson 经营的市场营销因素。

Barton provided extensive statistics on the mineral reserves, production capacity, selling rates, and marketing factors affecting Jefferson’s operations.

他还指出，一个新矿体尚未公开的初步钻探结果，可能显示存在可延长 Jefferson 主要矿山寿命的矿化带，但 Barton 没有引用有关初步钻探结果的具体数据。

He also noted that initial drilling results on a new ore body, which had not been made public, might show the existence of mineral zones that could increase the life of Jefferson’s main mines, but Barton cited no specific data as to the initial drilling results.

Grant 致电 Jefferson 的一位高管，对方通过电话向她提供了初步钻探结果。

Grant called an officer of Jefferson, who gave her the initial drilling results over the telephone.

数据显示，主要矿山的预期寿命将延长至原来的三倍。

The data indicated that the expected life of the main mines would be tripled.

Grant 将这些统计数据加入 Barton 的报告，并以自己的报告名义在公司内部传阅。

Grant added these statistics to Barton’s report and circulated it as her own report within her firm.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Grant 在自己的报告中大量复制 Barton 的报告，却未注明来源，构成剽窃，因此违反了准则 I(C)。

Comment: Grant plagiarized Barton’s report by reproducing large parts of it in her own report without acknowledgment and, therefore, violated Standard I(C).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 5：剽窃”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

外部资料的“可获得性”与“作者归属”是两件事。即使内容能免费下载或已在行业广泛流传，照搬独特分析、模型或表述时仍需要恰当注明来源；不能通过略改措辞掩盖借用。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

Standard I(C) — 禁止虚假陈述 / Misrepresentation

V10-M03-CA-032例 6：信息的虚假陈述
Example 6: Misrepresentation of Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 90

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 6：信息的虚假陈述 Example 6: Misrepresentation of Information

Marks 向公共养老金计划客户销售一种称为“纯利息剥离证券”（IO）的按揭支持衍生品时，将其描述为“由美国政府担保”。

When Marks sells mortgage-backed derivatives called “interest-only strips” (IOs) to public pension plan clients, she describes them as “guaranteed by the US government.”

但是，IO 的购买者仅有权获得按揭贷款产生的利息现金流，而无权获得名义本金本身。

Purchasers of the IOs are entitled only to the interest stream generated by the mortgages, however, not the notional principal itself.

某一市政当局的投资政策及当地法律要求，其公共养老金计划购买的证券必须由美国政府担保。

One particular municipality’s investment policies and local law require that securities purchased by its public pension plans be guaranteed by the US government.

虽然基础按揭贷款获得担保，但投资者投入的资金及 IO 的利息现金流均不受担保。

Although the underlying mortgages are guaranteed, neither the investor’s investment nor the interest stream on the IOs is guaranteed.

当利率下降导致按揭贷款提前还款增加时，IO 投资者获得的利息支付减少，投资者会损失部分投资。

When interest rates decline, causing an increase in prepayment of mortgages, interest payments to the IOs’ investors decline, and these investors lose a portion of their investment.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Marks 虚假陈述了投资的条款与性质，违反了准则 I(C)。

Comment: Marks violated Standard I(C) by misrepresenting the terms and character of the investment.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 6：信息的虚假陈述”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

V10-M03-CA-033例 7：潜在的信息虚假陈述
Example 7: Potential Information Misrepresentation

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 7：潜在的信息虚假陈述 Example 7: Potential Information Misrepresentation

Abdrabbo 为美国数位即将退休的高净值人士管理投资。

Abdrabbo manages the investments of several high-net-worth individuals in the United States who are approaching retirement.

Abdrabbo 建议他们将部分投资从股票转向银行发行的存款证及货币市场账户，使本金在一定金额以内获得“保障”。

Abdrabbo advises these individuals that a portion of their investments should be moved from equity to bank-sponsored certificates of deposit and money market accounts so that the principal will be “guaranteed” up to a certain amount.

利息则没有保障。

The interest is not guaranteed.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：虽然提供存款证及货币市场账户的机构可能破产，但在美国，这些账户由美国政府通过联邦存款保险公司提供保险保障。

Comment: Although there is risk that the institution offering the certificates of deposit and money market accounts could go bankrupt, in the United States, these accounts are insured by the US government through the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

因此，如果金额不超过政府保险保障上限，在这一背景下使用“保障”一词是适当的。

Therefore, using the term “guaranteed” in this context is appropriate if the amount is within the government-insured limit.

Abdrabbo 必须向客户解释这些事实。

Abdrabbo must explain these facts to the clients.

Example 8: Plagiarism

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 91

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 8：剽窃 Example 8: Plagiarism

Swanson 是 Ballard and Company 投资研究部门的资深分析师。

Swanson is a senior analyst in the investment research department of Ballard and Company.

Apex Corporation 请 Ballard 协助收购金融咨询公司 Campbell Company 的多数股权，并撰写一份报告，建议 Campbell 的股东同意该收购。

Apex Corporation has asked Ballard to assist in acquiring the majority ownership of stock in the Campbell Company, a financial consulting firm, and to prepare a report recommending that stockholders of Campbell agree to the acquisition.

另一家投资公司 Davis and Company 已经为 Apex 编制报告，分析 Apex 和 Campbell，并建议了换股比例。

Another investment firm, Davis and Company, had already prepared a report for Apex analyzing both Apex and Campbell and recommending an exchange ratio.

Apex 将 Davis 的报告交给 Ballard 的高管，后者又将报告转交给 Swanson。

Apex has given the Davis report to Ballard officers, who have passed it on to Swanson.

Swanson 审阅了 Davis 的报告，以及其他可获得的有关 Apex 和 Campbell 的资料。

Swanson reviews the Davis report and other available material on Apex and Campbell.

根据自己的分析，他认为 Campbell 和 Apex 的普通股在当前价格下都具有良好价值；但是，他认为 Davis 的报告没有考虑 Campbell 股东作出决定所需了解的全部因素。

From his analysis, he concludes that the common stocks of Campbell and Apex represent good value at their current prices; he believes, however, that the Davis report does not consider all the factors a Campbell stockholder would need to know to make a decision.

Swanson 向负责该项目的合伙人报告结论，对方却告诉他：“拿 Davis 的报告改几个字，签上你的名字，然后发出去。”

Swanson reports his conclusions to the partner in charge, who tells him to “use the Davis report, change a few words, sign your name, and get it out.”

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：如果 Swanson 按要求行事，就会违反准则 I(C)。

Comment: If Swanson does as requested, he will violate Standard I(C).

他可以引用 Davis 报告中自己认同的部分，但须注明 Davis 是来源；之后可以加入自己的分析和结论，再署名并分发报告。

He could refer to those portions of the Davis report that he agrees with if he identifies Davis as the source; he could then add his own analysis and conclusions to the report before signing and distributing it.

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

Example 9: Plagiarism

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 91

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 9：剽窃 Example 9: Plagiarism

Double Alpha, Inc. 的量化分析师 Browning 参加研讨会回来后十分兴奋。

Browning, a quantitative analyst for Double Alpha, Inc., is excited after returning from a seminar.

在研讨会上，一家全国性经纪公司知名的量化分析师 Jorrely 详细讨论了自己的一个新模型，Browning 对这些新概念产生了浓厚兴趣。

In that seminar, Jorrely, a well-publicized quantitative analyst at a national brokerage firm, discussed one of his new models in great detail, and Browning is intrigued by the new concepts.

他着手测试该模型，在保留基本概念的同时作了一些小幅修改，最终取得非常理想的结果。

He proceeds to test the model, making some minor changes but retaining the concepts, until he produces some very positive results.

Browning 很快向 Double Alpha 的主管宣布，自己发现了一个新模型，并称应将这一积极成果告知客户及潜在客户，作为 Double Alpha 持续创新及创造价值能力的进一步证明。

Browning quickly announces to his supervisors at Double Alpha that he has discovered a new model and that clients and prospective clients should be informed of this positive finding as ongoing proof of Double Alpha’s continuing innovation and ability to add value.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：虽然 Browning 自行测试了 Jorrely 的模型，甚至作了轻微修改，但他仍必须注明这一思路的原始来源。

Comment: Although Browning tested Jorrely’s model on his own and even slightly modified it, he must still acknowledge the original source of the idea.

Browning 当然可以将最终实际应用成果归于自己的工作，也可以用自己的测试支持结论。

Browning can certainly take credit for the final, practical results; he can also support his conclusions with his own test.

但是，创新思维的贡献必须归于 Jorrely。

The credit for the innovative thinking, however, must be given to Jorrely.

例 10：剽窃 Example 10: Plagiarism

Zubia 希望在公司的营销资料中，以“浅显语言”解释各种概念，例如市盈率（P/E），以及为何用标准差衡量风险。

Zubia would like to include in his firm’s marketing materials some “plain-language” descriptions of various concepts, such as the price-to-earnings (P/E) multiple and why standard deviation is used as a measure of risk.

这些解释来自其他来源，但 Zubia 希望不注明原作者便直接使用。

The descriptions come from other sources, but Zubia wishes to use them without reference to the original authors.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：逐字复制任何材料却不注明来源，包括对市盈率和标准差的通俗解释，均违反准则 I(C)。

Comment: Copying verbatim any material without acknowledgment, including plain-language descriptions of the P/E multiple and standard deviation, violates Standard I(C).

即使这些概念属于一般知识，最佳做法仍是 Zubia 用自己的语言解释，或引用说明文字的来源。

Even though these concepts are general, best practice would be for Zubia to describe them in his own words or cite the sources from which the descriptions are quoted.

如果会员与考生负责制作未注明来源的营销资料，或明知材料是剽窃所得仍使用，就会违反准则 I(C)。

Members and candidates would be violating Standard I(C) if they either were responsible for creating marketing materials without attribution or knowingly used plagiarized materials.

V10-M03-CA-037例 11：剽窃
Example 11: Plagiarism

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 92

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 11：剽窃 Example 11: Plagiarism

Schneider 通过一家主流媒体得知一项研究，希望在自己的研究中引用。

Through a mainstream media outlet, Schneider learns about a study that she would like to cite in her research.

她不确定在使用该信息时，是否应同时注明作为中介来源的主流媒体，以及研究本身的作者。

She questions whether she should cite both the mainstream intermediary source and the author of the study itself when using that information.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：在所有情况下，会员或考生都必须注明信息的实际来源。

Comment: In all instances, a member or candidate must cite the actual source of the information.

对 Schneider 而言，最佳做法是在报告中引用之前，直接向作者取得资料并审阅。

Best practice for Schneider would be to obtain the information directly from the author and review it before citing it in a report.

在这种情况下，Schneider 无须说明自己最初如何获知这一信息。

In that case, Schneider would not need to report how she found out about the information.

例如，假设 Schneider 在《金融时报》上读到有关 CFA 协会发布的一项研究；最佳做法是向 CFA 协会取得研究副本，审阅后再在自己的报告中引用。

For example, suppose Schneider read in the Financial Times about a study issued by CFA Institute; best practice for Schneider would be to obtain a copy of the study from CFA Institute, review it, and then cite it in her report.

如果她未使用《金融时报》对研究报告的任何解读，且该报并未为报告本身增加价值，那么报纸仅是获取原始信息的渠道，无须引用。

If she does not use any interpretation of the report from the Financial Times and the newspaper does not add value to the report itself, the newspaper is merely a conduit to the original information and does not need to be cited.

如果 Schneider 没有取得报告并审阅信息，就可能依赖错误陈述事实的二手资料。

If she does not obtain the report and review the information, Schneider runs the risk of relying on second-hand information that may misstate facts.

例如，如果《金融时报》错误报道了 CFA 协会原始研究中的某些信息，而 Schneider 复制了这些错误信息，她就会在自己的研究中纳入不实内容。

If, for example, the Financial Times erroneously reported some information from the original CFA Institute study and Schneider copied that erroneous information, she would be including misinformation in her research.

为避免可能违反准则 I(C)，Schneider 必须向原作者取得完整研究并仅引用该作者，或者使用中介提供的信息并同时引用两个来源。

To avoid a potential violation of Standard I(C), Schneider must obtain the complete study from its original author and cite only that author or use the information provided by the intermediary and cite both sources.

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-038例 12：信息的虚假陈述
Example 12: Misrepresentation of Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 92

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 12：信息的虚假陈述 Example 12: Misrepresentation of Information

Ostrowski 经营一家只有两人的投资管理公司。

Ostrowski runs a two-person investment management firm.

其公司订阅了一家大型投资研究公司的服务，获得可由小型公司重新包装后提供给自己客户的研究报告。

His firm subscribes to a service from a large investment research firm that provides research reports that can be repackaged by smaller firms for those firms’ clients.

Ostrowski 的公司将这些报告作为自己的研究成果分发给客户。

Ostrowski’s firm distributes these reports to clients as its own work.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Ostrowski 可以依赖具有合理且充分依据的第三方研究，但不得暗示自己是该研究的作者。

Comment: Ostrowski may rely on third-party research that has a reasonable and adequate basis, but he must not imply that he is the author of such research.

否则，Ostrowski 就是在虚假陈述自身工作的范围，并因此误导公司客户或潜在客户。

If he does, Ostrowski is misrepresenting the extent of his work in a way that misleads the firm’s clients or prospective clients.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 12：信息的虚假陈述”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

外包研究或管理不会外包自己的尽调责任。应了解服务商的方法、数据质量、能力、利益冲突与持续表现，并保留选择依据；仅凭名气或历史业绩不足。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-039例 13：信息的虚假陈述
Example 13: Misrepresentation of Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 92-93

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 13：信息的虚假陈述 Example 13: Misrepresentation of Information

Stafford 是 Appleton Investment Management 某团队的成员，该团队负责为 Open Air Bank 管理一组资产；Open Air Bank 向离岸客户销售结构性证券。

Stafford is part of a team at Appleton Investment Management responsible for managing a pool of assets for Open Air Bank, which distributes structured securities to offshore clients.

他发现，Open Air 在推广这些结构性证券时，将其风险描述得远低于自己及团队管理原始资产池所遵循投资管理政策的实际风险。

He becomes aware that Open Air is promoting the structured securities as a much less risky investment than the investment management policy followed by himself and the team to manage the original pool of assets.

此外，Open Air 为该资产池取得了一个独立评级，明显高估了投资质量。

Also, Open Air has procured an independent rating for the pool that significantly overstates the quality of the investments.

Stafford 向主管表达担忧，但主管回应称，产品属于 Open Air，全部营销及分销工作也由其负责。

Stafford communicates his concerns to his supervisor, who responds that Open Air owns the product and is responsible for all marketing and distribution.

Stafford 的主管还说，该产品不在 Appleton 所遵循的美国监管制度范围之内，而且产品的所有风险都已在招募说明书第 184 页底部披露。

Stafford’s supervisor goes on to say that the product is outside the US regulatory regime that Appleton follows and that all risks of the product are disclosed at the bottom of page 184 of the prospectus.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：作为投资团队成员，Stafford 有能力识别描述投资组合的材料有多准确；他担忧 Appleton 可能对风险虚假陈述承担责任，是正确的。

Comment: As a member of the investment team, Stafford is qualified to recognize the degree of accuracy of the materials that characterize the portfolio, and he is correct to be concerned about Appleton’s responsibility for a misrepresentation of the risks.

Stafford 必须继续向 Appleton 的合规人员及管理层跟进 Open Air 宣传不准确的问题。

Stafford must continue to pursue the issue of Open Air’s inaccurate promotion with Appleton’s compliance personnel and management.

如果 Stafford 参与推广、推荐或分发自己认为具有误导性的证券信息，就可能违反准则 I(C)。

Stafford cannot be part of promoting, recommending, or distributing information about securities that he considers misleading without potentially violating Standard I(C).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 13：信息的虚假陈述”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-040例 14：虚假陈述投资组合群的构建方式
Example 14: Misrepresenting Composite Construction

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 93

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 14：虚假陈述投资组合群的构建方式 Example 14: Misrepresenting Composite Construction

Palmer 是一家投资管理机构的业绩负责人。

Palmer is head of performance for an investment manager.

在被要求向数据库提供业绩数据时，他没有披露公司从投资组合群中剔除了表现逊于基准的账户。

When asked to provide performance numbers to databases, he avoids disclosing that the firm excludes from composites accounts that have underperformed their benchmark.

向数据库报告的投资组合群收益率，对未跑输基准的账户而言虽然准确，却未真实反映投资管理人的历史业绩。

The composite returns reported to the databases, although accurate for the accounts that have not underperformed their benchmark, do not present a true representation of the investment manager’s track record.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：在公开报告、向数据库提供的信息或向其他外部相关方提供的信息中，“挑选”有利账户纳入统计，不符合准则 I(C)。

Comment: “Cherry-picking” accounts to include in either published reports or information provided to databases or other external parties conflicts with Standard I(C).

在历史业绩中仅纳入表现最好的账户，会严重歪曲公司的投资组合群结果。

Selecting only the best-performing accounts to include in a track record materially misrepresents the firm’s composite results.

Palmer 应与公司合作，加强有关投资组合群构建的报告做法，以避免虚假陈述公司的历史业绩，或所提供信息的质量。

Palmer should work with his firm to strengthen its reporting practices concerning composite construction to avoid misrepresenting the firm’s track record or the quality of the information being provided.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 14：虚假陈述投资组合群的构建方式”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

绩效组合的构建决定比较是否公平。挑选表现最好账户、排除不利时期或改变归因方法却不说明，均可能把选择效果伪装成管理能力；应在一致范围和口径下报告。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-041例 15：提供过时信息
Example 15: Presenting Out-of-Date Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 93

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 15：提供过时信息 Example 15: Presenting Out-of-Date Information

Finch 是一家商业银行的销售总监，负责指导银行客户顾问销售第三方共同基金。

Finch is a sales director at a commercial bank, where he directs the bank’s client advisers in the sale of third-party mutual funds.

每个季度，他都会为整个部门举办培训，提供银行获准向客户销售的投资基金资料单。

Each quarter, he holds a division-wide training session where he provides fact sheets on investment funds the bank is allowed to offer to clients.

这些可转发给客户的资料单由共同基金公司制作，载有基金信息，包括投资策略及目标分派率。

These fact sheets, which can be redistributed to clients, are created by the mutual fund firms and contain information about the funds, including investment strategy and target distribution rates.

Finch 知道部分资料单已经过时；例如，一只只做多的基金上季度已获准大量使用杠杆来提高收益。

Finch knows that some of the fact sheets are out of date; for example, one long-only fund approved the use of significant leverage last quarter as a method to enhance returns.

但他继续向销售团队提供未更新的资料，因为银行无法控制共同基金公司发布的营销材料。

He continues to provide the sheets to the sales team without updates because the bank has no control over the marketing material released by the mutual fund firms.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Finch 提供了虚假描述基金某些特征的信息，违反准则 I(C)。

Comment: Finch is violating Standard I(C) by providing information that misrepresents aspects of the funds.

他未向销售团队及最终客户提供最新信息，使用过时资料单，歪曲了这些基金的潜在风险。

By not providing the sales team and, ultimately, the clients with the updated information, he is misrepresenting the potential risks associated with the funds with outdated fact sheets.

Finch 必须指示销售团队向客户说明资料单的缺陷，并确保在接受任何基金投资订单之前，客户已取得最新基金文件。

Finch must instruct the sales team to clarify the deficiencies in the fact sheets with clients and ensure they have the most recent fund documents before accepting orders for investing in any fund.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 15：提供过时信息”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

错误是否最初出于无意，主要影响起因，不改变发现之后的纠正责任。应停止继续分发错误版本、核实正确数据并通知受影响对象；明知不改会让后续陈述持续误导。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-042例 16：夸大 ESG 声明
Example 16: Overstating ESG Claims

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 94

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 16：夸大 ESG 声明 Example 16: Overstating ESG Claims

Lowery 管理 Majesty Fund，该基金于 2018 年成立，现已成为亚洲领先的环境、社会及治理（ESG）基金之一。

Lowery manages the Majesty Fund, which was established in 2018 and has become one of the leading Asian environmental, social, and governance (ESG) funds.

该基金的投资授权目标，是寻求可持续的财富创造。

The fund’s mandate is to seek sustainable wealth creation.

Lowery 使用第三方评级机构提供的 ESG 评分，评估基金的潜在投资。

Lowery uses ESG scores provided by third-party rating organizations to assess potential investments for the fund.

基金在宣传资料及客户协议中声称，会积极与持仓公司沟通，并行使代理投票权，以实现可持续增长。

The fund declares in promotional material and client agreements that it engages in proactive engagement and proxy voting for companies owned by the fund to create sustainable growth.

然而，Lowery 并未开展这两项活动中的任何一项。因此，该基金从未发布详细的股东参与报告，以说明其参与策略及成果。

However, Lowery has done neither of these activities. As a result, the fund has never published its detailed engagement reports that include its engagement strategy and its outcomes.

此外，基金也没有清楚说明其代理投票行为及其结果。

Moreover, there has been no clear communication by the fund regarding its proxy voting and its consequences.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：如果公司声称旗下某只基金考虑 ESG 因素，就必须清楚解释其含义，不得夸大基金在可持续性、社会影响或治理方面的资质和表现。

Comment: A firm that describes one of its funds as considering ESG factors must clearly describe what that means and not overstate the sustainability, social impact, or governance credentials of the fund.

Lowery 声称基金会积极与持仓公司的管理层沟通并行使代理投票权，以实现可持续增长，却未实际开展这些活动，因而虚假描述了基金，未符合准则 I(C)。

By stating that the fund would conduct proactive engagement with management and proxy voting for companies owned by the fund in order to create sustainable growth and failing to do so, Lowery misrepresented the fund and failed to meet Standard I(C).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 16：夸大 ESG 声明”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

ESG宣传要和实际研究、持仓、筛选方法及监控过程一致。把有限筛选包装成全面可持续性承诺，会使客户对服务产生错误印象；宽泛标签不能代替可核验的执行标准。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-043例 17：误导性地描述服务
Example 17: Misleading Description of Services

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 94

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 17：误导性地描述服务 Example 17: Misleading Description of Services

多年来，Stafford 一直是 Lionsgate LLP 的合伙人。这是一家提供全面服务的大型会计师事务所，主要在投资业绩领域提供审计及其他服务。

For many years, Stafford was a partner at Lionsgate LLP, a large, full-service accounting firm that provides audit and other services, primarily in the area of investment performance.

她与一名初级员工一同离开 Lionsgate，成立了自己的公司 Angelwood Analytics。

She leaves Lionsgate, with a junior associate, to form her own firm, Angelwood Analytics.

Angelwood 的网站、社交媒体及印刷营销资料大力强调 Stafford 的专长和经验，并声称她会亲自参与所有客户工作。

Angelwood’s website, social media, and print marketing heavily emphasize Stafford’s expertise and experience and state that Stafford will be personally involved in all client work.

Angelwood 最初的客户规模较小，但后来 Stafford 吸引到了数家大客户。

Angelwood’s clients are small at first, but eventually Stafford attracts several large clients.

为服务这些较大客户，她转为承担监督角色，并聘用新员工服务长期客户。

To service these larger clients, she transitions to an oversight role and hires new staff to work with her longtime clients.

业务发展十分成功，Stafford 开始聘用第三方承包人员，最终这些人员为 Angelwood 超过 50% 的工作提供支持。

Business becomes so successful that Stafford resorts to hiring third-party contractors that eventually provide support for over 50% of Angelwood’s work.

她聘用的人员具备资格，行业惯例允许在此类工作中使用第三方承包人员，而且 Angelwood 的客户协议规定，公司有权自行决定每位客户的人员配置。

The staff she uses are qualified, industry practice allows use of third-party contractors for the work, and Angelwood’s client agreement states that staffing decisions for each client are discretionary for the firm.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Stafford 的沟通未能根据实际情况做到准确、完整，违反了准则 I(C)。

Comment: Stafford violated Standard I(C) since her communications were not accurate and complete given the circumstances.

Stafford 通过其公司提供的信息，未准确描述公司如何配置人员，以执行她所宣传的服务。

Stafford, through her firm, did not accurately describe how her firm was staffed to perform the services that she promoted.

Stafford 一方面声称客户可以获得她的知识和专长，另一方面却越来越依赖初级员工及第三方人员。

While stating that clients could expect her knowledge and expertise, Stafford increasingly relied on junior employees and third-party staffers.

这种人员安排本身可以接受，但她在宣传公司时，没有完整说明 Angelwood 将如何为客户提供投资服务。

While this was acceptable, she did not give a complete picture of how Angelwood will be providing investment services for clients when promoting the firm.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 17：误导性地描述服务”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

社交媒体也是专业沟通渠道。发布重要建议时应依照合理分发政策，避免只让某个小群体获得不公平优势；不同服务级别可存在，但应披露并确保其他客户的公平机会不受损害。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-044例 18：不准确、过时的历史业绩
Example 18: Inaccurate, Dated Performance History

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 94-95

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 18：不准确、过时的历史业绩 Example 18: Inaccurate, Dated Performance History

过去二十年，Huggins 一直经营一家为零售客户及高净值人士服务的投资咨询公司。

For the past two decades, Huggins has managed an investment advisory firm catering to retail clients and high-net-worth individuals.

总体而言，公司过去五年的投资业绩令人满意，但自全球疫情开始以来，业绩已明显下降。

Overall, the investment performance history of the firm for the past five years has been satisfactory, but since the onset of the global pandemic, performance has dropped appreciably.

Huggins 在公司网站上展示基金五年的历史业绩，以说服潜在客户聘用公司提供咨询服务。

On the firm’s website, Huggins provides the five-year performance history of the fund as a way to convince potential clients to hire his firm for advisory services.

虽然相关信息已经可得，他却没有更新网站，说明疫情开始以来的业绩并不出色。

He does not update the information on the website to clarify that the performance history since the beginning of the pandemic has been less than stellar, even though that information is available.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Huggins 在向潜在客户营销时，未提供准确、及时的信息，违反了准则 I(C)。

Comment: Huggins violated Standard I(C) by not providing accurate and timely information as part of his marketing to potential clients.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 18：不准确、过时的历史业绩”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

错误是否最初出于无意，主要影响起因，不改变发现之后的纠正责任。应停止继续分发错误版本、核实正确数据并通知受影响对象；明知不改会让后续陈述持续误导。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

Standard I(C) — 禁止虚假陈述 / Misrepresentation

V10-M03-CA-045例 19：信息不足或遗漏
Example 19: Insufficient, Omitted Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 95

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 19：信息不足或遗漏 Example 19: Insufficient, Omitted Information

Hamilton 是一家私募股权基金的研究分析师，该基金专注于 ESG 领域的影响力投资。

Hamilton is a research analyst for a private equity fund focused on impact investing in the ESG space.

Hamilton 编制了数份研究报告，分发给潜在投资者，大致展示并描述基金选择 ESG 投资时遵循的流程。

Hamilton creates several research reports to distribute to potential investors that generally demonstrate and describe the process the fund goes through when choosing ESG investments.

提供给潜在投资者的报告，不如投资者承诺投资基金后获得的研究报告详细。

The reports for potential investors are not as detailed as the research reports provided to investors once they commit to investing in the fund.

一位慈善基金会投资者在承诺向基金投入 5,000 万美元后，收到了更详细的报告。

After committing US$50 million to the fund, one investor, a charitable foundation, receives the more detailed reports.

该基金会的首席投资官感到不满，因为这只私募股权基金似乎过度配置尚在开发中的技术，因此投资风险高于 Hamilton 最初提供的一般信息所显示的水平。

The chief investment officer of the foundation is unhappy that the private equity fund seems overweighted in developing technology and therefore represents a riskier investment than was indicated by the more general information initially provided by Hamilton.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：会员与考生履行准则 I(C) 的责任时，提供的信息必须适合具体情况。

Comment: The information provided by members and candidates when meeting their responsibilities under Standard I(C) must be appropriate for the circumstances.

在某些情况下，对尚未成为客户的潜在投资者限制信息范围，同时向已建立客户关系的人提供更详细的披露及投资流程信息，可能是适当的。

In some circumstances, it may be appropriate to limit the information provided to potential investors, who are not yet clients, while providing more detailed disclosures and information about the investment process to those who have already entered into a client relationship.

但是，限制信息不得达到歪曲投资性质或风险的程度。

However, limiting information cannot rise to the level of misrepresenting the nature or risks of the investment.

在本例中，Hamilton 似乎仅就基金投资于尚在开发技术的程度提供了有限信息，因而不当地歪曲了投资的真实风险水平，违反准则 I(C)。

In this case, Hamilton appears to have provided only limited information about the extent to which the fund is invested in developing technology and therefore violated Standard I(C) by improperly misrepresenting the true level of risk of the investment.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 19：信息不足或遗漏”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

授权范围改变会改变客户原先同意承担的风险。即使经理相信新策略回报更好，也不能未经适当沟通或授权就越过既定风格、资产类别和风险限制。

推理顺序：逐项核对承诺、历史数据、来源和适用范围；发现无意错误后及时更正并通知受影响者。引用外部研究、模型或文字时保留适当出处。

为什么容易选错：收益最终实现不代表当初的无条件保证合规；资料来自公开网站也不意味着可以不注明来源。雇主拥有的内部研究与外部作者研究的归属要求须区分。

V10-M03-CA-046例 20：误导性地描述服务、虚假陈述知识水平
Example 20: Misleading Description of Service, Misrepresenting Knowledge

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 95

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 20：误导性地描述服务、虚假陈述知识水平 Example 20: Misleading Description of Service, Misrepresenting Knowledge

某发展中国家的主权财富基金正在寻找投资管理人，管理基金的部分资产。

The sovereign wealth fund of a developing country is seeking an investment manager to manage a portion of the fund’s assets.

基金董事认为，在投资流程中使用人工智能（AI）工具可以带来效率、创新及盈利能力提升，希望利用这些优势。

The fund’s directors want to take advantage of the efficiencies, innovation, and increased profitability they believe are available through the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the investment process.

因此，他们在发给潜在管理人的建议书征询文件（RFP）中，加入了数个有关人工智能使用情况的问题。

As such, they include several questions on the use of artificial intelligence on the request for proposal (RFP) sent out to potential managers.

AWZ Investment Advisers 的首席执行官 Al-Wazir 决心在此次管理人遴选中保持竞争力，尽管其公司才刚开始探索如何运用人工智能改善投资业绩。

Al-Wazir, CEO of AWZ Investment Advisers, is intent on being competitive in the fund’s manager search, even though his firm is just beginning to explore AI to enhance investment performance.

为给出一个看似全面且专业的回答，他使用 ChatGPT 完成 RFP 中要求各应征管理人说明如何将 AI 纳入投资流程的部分。

Wanting to provide a seemingly thorough and knowledgeable answer, he uses ChatGPT to complete the portion of the RFP asking for a narrative of how each responding manager incorporates AI in its investment process.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Al-Wazir 虚假陈述公司在投资流程中应用 AI 的能力，并用 ChatGPT 回答 RFP，以掩盖自己对该主题的浅薄了解，显得比实际更专业，因此违反了准则 I(C)。

Comment: Al-Wazir violated Standard I(C) by misrepresenting his firm’s capabilities relating to AI in its investment process and using ChatGPT to respond to the RFP to hide his superficial knowledge of the topic and seem more knowledgeable than he is.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 20：误导性地描述服务、虚假陈述知识水平”应放在准则 I(C) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：虚假陈述既包括直接说假话，也包括遗漏重要限制、夸大能力、选择性展示数据及未经归属使用他人思想。判断重点是客户或读者会形成怎样的实质印象。

V10-M03-CA-047例 1：专业精神与胜任能力
Example 1: Professionalism and Competence

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 97

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 1：专业精神与胜任能力 Example 1: Professionalism and Competence

Sasserman 是一个富裕小镇某家银行的信托投资主管。

Sasserman is a trust investment officer at a bank in a small, affluent town.

他喜欢每天与朋友在乡村俱乐部共进午餐，客户曾看到他在那里喝下多杯酒。

He enjoys lunching every day with friends at the country club, where his clients have observed him having numerous drinks.

午餐后回到工作岗位，他在作出投资决策时明显处于醉酒状态。

Back at work after lunch, he clearly is intoxicated while making investment decisions.

同事故意把与 Sasserman 有关的业务安排在上午，因为他们不信任他午餐后的判断。

His colleagues make a point of handling any business with Sasserman in the morning because they distrust his judgment after lunch.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Sasserman 午餐时过量饮酒、随后醉酒工作，令人质疑其专业精神及胜任能力，因此违反准则 I(D)。

Comment: Sasserman’s excessive drinking at lunch and subsequent intoxication at work constitute a violation of Standard I(D) because this conduct has raised questions about his professionalism and competence.

他的行为对自己、雇主及投资行业都造成了负面影响。

His behavior reflects poorly on him, his employer, and the investment industry.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 1：专业精神与胜任能力”应放在准则 I(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：禁止与职业诚信、声誉或胜任能力相冲突的欺诈、欺骗和其他不诚实行为。判断应联系职业责任与诚信影响，不是把所有私人不当、争议或违法一律当成准则违规。

推理顺序：识别行为中的故意欺骗、利益侵占或诚信损害，再评估其与专业能力或职业声誉的关系。事实是否发生在工作场所并不是唯一标准。

为什么容易选错：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(D) — 不当行为 / Misconduct

相关边界：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

V10-M03-CA-048例 2：欺诈与欺骗
Example 2: Fraud and Deceit

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 97

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 2：欺诈与欺骗 Example 2: Fraud and Deceit

Hoffman 是大型经纪公司 ATZ Brothers, Inc. 的证券分析师。在两年内，他向 ATZ 自筹资金的医疗保险计划提交了二十多张账单的报销申请，其中大多数账单经过篡改，以提高应付金额。

Hoffman, a security analyst at ATZ Brothers, Inc., a large brokerage house, submits reimbursement forms over a two-year period to ATZ’s self-funded health insurance program for more than two dozen bills, most of which have been altered to increase the amount due.

公司员工福利主管调查后，发现了这一不当行为。

An investigation by the firm’s director of employee benefits uncovers the inappropriate conduct.

随后，ATZ 解雇了 Hoffman，并通知 CFA 协会。

ATZ subsequently terminates Hoffman’s employment and notifies CFA Institute.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Hoffman 在工作场所故意实施欺诈与欺骗行为，损害了其诚信，因此违反了准则 I(D)。

Comment: Hoffman violated Standard I(D) because he engaged in intentional conduct involving fraud and deceit in the workplace that adversely reflected on his integrity.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 2：欺诈与欺骗”应放在准则 I(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：禁止与职业诚信、声誉或胜任能力相冲突的欺诈、欺骗和其他不诚实行为。判断应联系职业责任与诚信影响，不是把所有私人不当、争议或违法一律当成准则违规。

推理顺序：识别行为中的故意欺骗、利益侵占或诚信损害，再评估其与专业能力或职业声誉的关系。事实是否发生在工作场所并不是唯一标准。

为什么容易选错：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

V10-M03-CA-049例 3：欺诈与欺骗
Example 3: Fraud and Deceit

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 98

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 3：欺诈与欺骗 Example 3: Fraud and Deceit

Brink 是一名覆盖汽车行业的分析师，也是一家非常成功的精品投资研究公司的首席执行官。

Brink, an analyst covering the automotive industry, is CEO of a very successful boutique investment research firm.

由于她是社区知名人士，又是拥有多年投资行业经验的 CFA 持证人，数家当地慈善机构邀请她加入董事会，她以志愿者身份接受了邀请。

Because she is a prominent member of the community and a CFA charterholder with years of experience in the investment industry, several local charities ask Brink to sit on their board, and she does so as a volunteer.

其中一家慈善机构的董事会决定购买五辆新厢式货车，为低收入老年人配送热午餐。

The board of one of the charitable institutions for which Brink serves on the board decides to buy five new vans to deliver hot lunches to low-income elderly people.

Brink 主动提出处理采购协议。为偿还欠一位经营汽车经销店朋友的长期债务，并补偿自己的辛劳，她同意以高于正常价格 20% 的价格采购，再与朋友瓜分加价部分。

Brink offers to handle purchasing agreements. To pay a long-standing debt to a friend who operates an automobile dealership—and to compensate herself for her trouble—she agrees to a price 20% higher than normal and splits the surcharge with her friend.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：就本准则而言，Brink 在慈善组织董事会的志愿工作属于职业活动，因为她是凭借资深投资分析师及 CFA 持证人的身份获邀任职。

Comment: Brink’s volunteer work for the board of the charitable organization is a professional activity for the purposes of this standard since she serves on the board because of her status as an experienced investment analyst and CFA charterholder.

Brink 实施了涉及不诚实、欺诈及虚假陈述的不当行为，违反了准则 I(D)。

Brink engaged in misconduct involving dishonesty, fraud, and misrepresentation and violated Standard I(D).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 3：欺诈与欺骗”应放在准则 I(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：禁止与职业诚信、声誉或胜任能力相冲突的欺诈、欺骗和其他不诚实行为。判断应联系职业责任与诚信影响，不是把所有私人不当、争议或违法一律当成准则违规。

志愿职位同样可能接触保密资料、资金或影响力。无偿服务不会免除诚信义务，职位获得的信息不能被挪用于个人利益或传播给无权获知者。

推理顺序：识别行为中的故意欺骗、利益侵占或诚信损害，再评估其与专业能力或职业声誉的关系。事实是否发生在工作场所并不是唯一标准。

为什么容易选错：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(D) — 不当行为 / Misconduct

相关边界：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

V10-M03-CA-050例 4：个人行为与诚信
Example 4: Personal Actions and Integrity

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 98

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 4：个人行为与诚信 Example 4: Personal Actions and Integrity

Garcia 管理一只致力于社会责任投资的共同基金。

Garcia manages a mutual fund dedicated to socially responsible investing.

她同时是一名环保活动人士。由于参与非暴力抗议活动，Garcia 多次因擅闯一家被指破坏环境的大型石化工厂的物业而遭逮捕。

She is also an environmental activist. As a result of her participation in nonviolent protests, Garcia has been arrested on numerous occasions for trespassing on the property of a large petrochemical plant that is accused of damaging the environment.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：一般而言，准则 I(D) 并非旨在涵盖为支持个人信念而实施公民抗命所导致的违法行为，因为此类行为不会对会员或考生的职业声誉、诚信或胜任能力产生负面影响。

Comment: Generally, Standard I(D) is not meant to cover legal transgressions resulting from acts of civil disobedience in support of personal beliefs, because such conduct does not reflect poorly on the member’s or candidate’s professional reputation, integrity, or competence.

V10-M03-CA-051例 5：作为 CFA 协会地方分会志愿者实施不当行为
Example 5: Misconduct as a CFA Institute Society Volunteer

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 98

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 5：作为 CFA 协会地方分会志愿者实施不当行为 Example 5: Misconduct as a CFA Institute Society Volunteer

O’Hara 在当地分会担任志愿讲师，为当地 CFA 项目考生教授分会开设的 CFA 考试复习课程。

O’Hara volunteers at his local society as an instructor at the society’s CFA exam review course for local candidates in the CFA Program.

O’Hara 对数名女性考生实施不当行为，包括发表带有性暗示的言论、进行不受欢迎的身体接触，以及在遭拒绝后仍反复邀请考生约会。

O’Hara engages in inappropriate behavior with several female candidates that includes making suggestive remarks, unwanted touching, and repeatedly asking candidates out on dates despite being rebuffed by them.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：O’Hara 实施性骚扰，对其职业声誉和诚信产生负面影响，违反了准则 I(D)。

Comment: O’Hara is in violation of Standard I(D) by engaging in sexual harassment that reflects poorly on his professional reputation and integrity.

虽然这些行为没有发生在工作场所，但它们发生于 O’Hara 为当地分会提供服务的过程中，并涉及使用其特许资格及组织会员身份，因此属于《道德准则与专业行为准则》所指的职业行为。

Although the actions do not take place in the workplace, O’Hara’s actions are professional conduct within the meaning of the Code and Standards because the conduct takes place as part of his work with the local society and encompasses the use of his charter and membership in the organization.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 5：作为 CFA 协会地方分会志愿者实施不当行为”应放在准则 I(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：禁止与职业诚信、声誉或胜任能力相冲突的欺诈、欺骗和其他不诚实行为。判断应联系职业责任与诚信影响，不是把所有私人不当、争议或违法一律当成准则违规。

志愿职位同样可能接触保密资料、资金或影响力。无偿服务不会免除诚信义务，职位获得的信息不能被挪用于个人利益或传播给无权获知者。

推理顺序：识别行为中的故意欺骗、利益侵占或诚信损害，再评估其与专业能力或职业声誉的关系。事实是否发生在工作场所并不是唯一标准。

为什么容易选错：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(D) — 不当行为 / Misconduct

相关边界：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

V10-M03-CA-052例 6：表明 CFA 持证人身份
Example 6: Identification as a CFA Charterholder

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 98-99

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 6：表明 CFA 持证人身份 Example 6: Identification as a CFA Charterholder

Nehjer 曾在一家投资顾问机构担任经济学家，事业有成，最近退休后搬到自己的乡间庄园居住。

Nehjer recently retired from a successful career as an economist for an investment adviser to live at her country estate.

她仍维持 CFA 协会及当地分会的有效会员资格。

She maintains active CFA Institute membership with the organization and the local society.

一家跨国公司宣布，计划在距离其庄园 5 公里以内开设一家大型赌场。

A multinational firm has announced its intention to open a large casino within 5 km of her estate.

当地官员正在权衡赌场带来的积极经济影响，以及对社区特色产生的负面影响。

Local officials are balancing the positive economic impact of the casino with the negative effects it will have on the character of the community.

Nehjer 及邻居强烈反对赌场项目。

Nehjer and her neighbors strenuously object to the casino.

她发表公开信，声称研究显示，博彩场所的积极经济影响普遍被严重夸大。

She publishes an open letter stating that studies have shown that the positive economic impact of gambling venues is widely overblown.

她在信中引用了多项由自己编造或篡改的统计数据，以支持其论点。

She cites a number of statistics in her letter that she fabricated or altered to help make her point.

她在信末署名，并注明自己拥有博士学位，而且是 CFA 持证人。

She signs her name to the letter, indicating that she has a PhD and is a CFA charterholder.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Nehjer 为支持自己对赌场问题的观点，使用捏造和篡改的统计数据，实施了欺诈、不诚实及欺骗行为，构成不当行为，违反准则 I(D)。

Comment: By engaging in fraud, dishonesty, and deceit in using fabricated and altered statistics in an effort to support her opinion on the casino issue, Nehjer engaged in misconduct and violated Standard I(D).

虽然已退休，但她在本例中表明 CFA 持证人身份，并明确利用该资格增强自己分析及观点的可信度，因此其行为属于本准则所指的职业行为。

Although she is retired, her actions in this case are professional conduct within the meaning of the standard because she identified herself as a CFA charterholder and explicitly used her charter in an attempt to give her analysis and opinions more credibility.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 6：表明 CFA 持证人身份”应放在准则 I(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：禁止与职业诚信、声誉或胜任能力相冲突的欺诈、欺骗和其他不诚实行为。判断应联系职业责任与诚信影响，不是把所有私人不当、争议或违法一律当成准则违规。

把真实资格状态与营销推论拆开。可以如实陈述考试经历，但称号使用取决于有效资格和会员要求；不应把通过速度或称号本身转化为优越投资业绩的保证。

推理顺序：识别行为中的故意欺骗、利益侵占或诚信损害，再评估其与专业能力或职业声誉的关系。事实是否发生在工作场所并不是唯一标准。

为什么容易选错：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard I(D) — 不当行为 / Misconduct

相关边界：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。

V10-M03-CA-053例 7：在工作场所或学术环境之外撰写投资内容
Example 7: Writing about Investments Outside the Workplace or Academia

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 99

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 7：在工作场所或学术环境之外撰写投资内容 Example 7: Writing about Investments Outside the Workplace or Academia

Mewis 是一家投资咨询公司的分析师，也是 CFA 考生。

Mewis is an analyst for an investment advisory firm and a candidate for the CFA designation.

她对环境保护及应对气候变化有浓厚兴趣。

She has a strong interest in environmental protection and combatting climate change.

她开设了一个博客，根据对公司环境、社会及治理（ESG）因素的评估，分析投资机会并推荐股票。

She starts a blog in which she provides analysis of investment opportunities and makes stock picks for companies based on her evaluation of their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors.

她为雇主开展的工作与 ESG 分析无关；雇主允许她创建博客，但条件是 ESG 相关工作须在个人时间完成，而且不得表明自己是该公司的分析师。

Her work with her employer is unrelated to ESG analysis, and her employer gives permission for her to create the blog if her ESG-related work is done on her own time and she does not identify herself as an analyst for the firm.

在一篇博客中，Mewis 严厉批评 JKL 公司在制造过程中严重破坏环境，并指责其管理层无能。

In one of her blog posts, Mewis severely criticizes JKL company for causing substantial harm to the environment in its manufacturing process and having incompetent management.

她在博客中声称，公司很可能很快面临监管行动及私人诉讼，严重影响 JKL 的盈利能力。

She posts on her blog that the company is likely soon to be the subject of regulatory action and private litigation that will greatly affect JKL’s profitability.

Mewis 并不知道这些说法是否属实；她之所以想损害该公司，是因为与担任公司首席执行官的前夫存在私人纠纷。

Mewis has no knowledge that any of this is true but seeks to damage the company because of a personal dispute with her ex-husband, the CEO of the company.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Mewis 实施了不诚实、欺诈及欺骗行为，并损害其职业声誉和诚信，违反了准则 I(D)。

Comment: Mewis violated Standard I(D) by engaging in dishonesty, fraud, and deceit and in conduct that reflects adversely on her professional reputation and integrity.

虽然这些行为与她在投资顾问机构的雇佣工作无关，但涉及她作为考生参与投资行业和证券市场的活动。

Although her actions are not related to her employment with the investment adviser, her conduct relates to the candidate’s involvement in the investment profession and security markets.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 7：在工作场所或学术环境之外撰写投资内容”应放在准则 I(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：禁止与职业诚信、声誉或胜任能力相冲突的欺诈、欺骗和其他不诚实行为。判断应联系职业责任与诚信影响，不是把所有私人不当、争议或违法一律当成准则违规。

推理顺序：识别行为中的故意欺骗、利益侵占或诚信损害，再评估其与专业能力或职业声誉的关系。事实是否发生在工作场所并不是唯一标准。

为什么容易选错：个人破产、政治抗议或其他私人事件不能仅凭标签认定违规；但利用志愿职位或工作身份实施欺骗也不能以“不是投资业务”开脱。
