V10-M05-CA-042例 1：业绩计算与时间长度
Example 1: Performance Calculation and Length of Time

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 155

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 1：业绩计算与时间长度 Example 1: Performance Calculation and Length of Time

Taylor Trust Company 的 Taylor 向潜在客户分发宣传册，声称公司资产持续实现“每年增长 25%”。

Taylor of Taylor Trust Company distributes a brochure to potential clients stating that the firm consistently achieves “25% annual growth” of assets.

Taylor Trust 的共同信托基金上一年的确增长了 25%，与整体市场涨幅相同。

Taylor Trust’s common trust fund did increase 25% for the previous year, which mirrored the increase of the overall market.

但在去年之前，该基金从未实现过 25% 的年度增长率，而 Taylor Trust 所有账户过去五年的平均年增长率为 5%。

The fund never had an annual growth rate of 25% prior to last year, and the average rate of growth of all of Taylor Trust accounts for five years is 5% per year.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Taylor 的宣传册违反了准则 III(D)。

Comment: Taylor’s brochure is in violation of Standard III(D).

Taylor 必须披露，25% 的增长只发生在某一年，而且仅涉及公司的共同信托基金。

Taylor must disclose that the 25% growth occurred only in one year and only for the firm’s common trust fund.

关于公司整体业绩的一般性声明，必须考虑所有类别账户的表现。

A general claim of firm performance must take into account the performance of all categories of accounts.

Taylor 声称客户可以预期稳定的 25% 年复合增长率，是将某个组合单一年度的实际业绩，虚假表述为预期业绩。

By stating that clients can expect a steady 25% annual compound growth rate, Taylor is misrepresenting one portfolio’s single-year actual performance as expected performance.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 1：业绩计算与时间长度”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(D) — 业绩呈现 / Performance Presentation

相关边界：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-043例 2：业绩计算与资产加权
Example 2: Performance Calculation and Asset Weighting

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 155

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 2：业绩计算与资产加权 Example 2: Performance Calculation and Asset Weighting

Alexander Capital Management 的高级合伙人 Judd，分发了资本增值账户 2008 至 2022 年的业绩报告。

Judd, a senior partner at Alexander Capital Management, circulates a performance report for the capital appreciation accounts for the years 2008 through 2022.

公司声称符合 GIPS 标准。然而，回报并未按 GIPS 要求计算，因为组合群回报没有按照各组合资产规模加权。

The firm claims compliance with the GIPS standards. Returns are not calculated in accordance with the requirements of the GIPS standards, however, because the composite returns are not calculated by asset weighting portfolio returns.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Judd 违反了准则 III(D)。公司声称符合 GIPS 标准时，必须满足所有要求、作出强制披露，并满足适用于该公司具体情况的其他要求。

Comment: Judd violated Standard III(D). When claiming compliance with the GIPS standards, firms must meet all the requirements, make mandatory disclosures, and meet any other requirements that apply to that firm’s specific situation.

GIPS 标准要求公司按资产规模加权各投资组合回报，以计算组合群回报。

The GIPS standards require firms to asset weight portfolio returns to calculate composite returns.

Judd 的违规并非源于滥用数据，而是因为发布的业绩报告包含公司符合 GIPS 标准的虚假声明。

Judd’s violation is not from any misuse of the data but from publishing a performance report with her firm’s false claim of GIPS compliance.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 2：业绩计算与资产加权”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

绩效组合的构建决定比较是否公平。挑选表现最好账户、排除不利时期或改变归因方法却不说明，均可能把选择效果伪装成管理能力；应在一致范围和口径下报告。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(D) — 业绩呈现 / Performance Presentation

相关边界：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-044例 3：业绩展示与先前基金／雇主
Example 3: Performance Presentation and Prior Fund/Employer

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 155-156

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 3：业绩展示与先前基金／雇主 Example 3: Performance Presentation and Prior Fund/Employer

McCoy 是新成立的 Mastermind Financial Advisers 股权投资部门的副总裁兼管理合伙人。

McCoy is vice president and managing partner of the equity investment group of Mastermind Financial Advisers, a new business.

Mastermind 招聘 McCoy，是因为他在 G&P Financial 拥有经证实的六年业绩记录。

Mastermind recruited McCoy because he had a proven six-year track record with G&P Financial.

在设计 Mastermind 的广告及营销活动时，McCoy 制作了一则广告，包含他在 G&P Financial 取得的股票投资业绩。

In developing Mastermind’s advertising and marketing campaign, McCoy prepares an advertisement that includes the equity investment performance he achieved at G&P Financial.

Mastermind 的广告没有说明该股票业绩是在 G&P 任职期间取得的。广告被分发给 Mastermind 的现有及潜在客户。

The advertisement for Mastermind does not identify the equity performance as being earned while at G&P. The advertisement is distributed to existing clients and prospective clients of Mastermind.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：McCoy 分发的广告对 Mastermind 的历史业绩作出重大虚假陈述，违反了准则 III(D)。

Comment: McCoy violated Standard III(D) by distributing an advertisement that contains material misrepresentations about the historical performance of Mastermind.

准则 III(D) 要求会员与考生作出合理努力，确保业绩信息公平、准确、完整地反映个人或公司的表现。

Standard III(D) requires that members and candidates make reasonable efforts to ensure that performance information is a fair, accurate, and complete representation of an individual’s or firm’s performance.

一般而言，本准则不禁止将先前任职公司所管理账户的历史业绩作为业绩记录的一部分展示，只要适当披露业绩产生的机构，以及该人士在取得业绩过程中承担的具体角色。

As a general matter, this standard does not prohibit showing past performance of accounts managed at a prior firm as part of a performance track record as long as showing that record is accompanied by appropriate disclosures about where the performance took place and the person’s specific role in achieving that performance.

如果 McCoy 选择在 Mastermind 广告中使用自己在 G&P 的过往业绩，就必须充分披露该历史业绩的来源。

If McCoy chooses to use his past performance from G&P in Mastermind’s advertising, he must make full disclosure of the source of the historical performance.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 3：业绩展示与先前基金／雇主”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

个人经验可以随人离职，雇主拥有的研究、客户资料和记录通常不能。若要展示旧业绩或使用旧研究，应有可验证记录、相应授权并准确交代角色和时间，不能把团队/机构成果据为己有。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

Standard III(D) — 业绩呈现 / Performance Presentation

相关边界：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-045例 4：业绩展示与模拟结果
Example 4: Performance Presentation and Simulated Results

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 156

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 4：业绩展示与模拟结果 Example 4: Performance Presentation and Simulated Results

Davis 根据 2000 至 2015 年的历史信息，开发了一款共同基金筛选产品。

Davis developed a mutual fund selection product based on historical information from 2000 to 2015.

Davis 将其方法回溯应用于 2016 至 2022 年的数据进行测试，得到这些年度的模拟业绩。

Davis tests his methodology by applying it retroactively to data from the 2016–22 period, thus producing simulated performance results for those years.

2023 年 1 月，Davis 的雇主决定推出该产品，他开始通过行业刊物广告及直接向客户发送资料进行推广。

In January 2023, Davis’s employer decides to offer the product and Davis begins promoting it through trade journal advertisements and direct dissemination to clients.

广告包含 2016 至 2022 年的业绩结果，却没有说明这些结果属于模拟。

The advertisements include the performance results for the 2016–22 period but do not indicate that the results were simulated.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Davis 未明确标示模拟业绩结果，违反了准则 III(D)。

Comment: Davis violated Standard III(D) by failing to clearly identify simulated performance results.

准则 III(D) 禁止会员与考生作出任何歪曲自身或公司实际业绩的陈述，并要求尽一切合理努力，确保向客户展示的业绩信息公平、准确且完整。

Standard III(D) prohibits members and candidates from making any statements that misrepresent the performance achieved by them or their firms and requires members and candidates to make every reasonable effort to ensure that performance information presented to clients is fair, accurate, and complete.

Davis 使用模拟结果时，必须充分披露业绩数据的来源，包括说明 2016 至 2022 年的结果，是将模型回溯应用于该期间所得。

Davis’s use of simulated results must be accompanied by full disclosure as to the source of the performance data, including the fact that the results from 2016 through 2022 are the result of applying the model retroactively to that time period.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 4：业绩展示与模拟结果”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

回测或模拟结果受样本选择、事后信息、交易成本及执行假设影响。应明确标识为模拟，说明关键假设与限制，不能让读者误以为是实盘管理历史。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-046例 5：业绩计算与仅选取部分账户
Example 5: Performance Calculation and Selected Accounts Only

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 156-157

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 5：业绩计算与仅选取部分账户 Example 5: Performance Calculation and Selected Accounts Only

在为潜在客户准备的演示资料中，Kilmer 展示了公司以“平衡”为目标的全权委托账户所组成“组合群”在五年期间取得的回报率。

In a presentation prepared for prospective clients, Kilmer shows the rates of return realized over a five-year period by a “composite” of his firm’s discretionary accounts that have a “balanced” objective.

然而，该组合群仅包含少数符合公司平衡标准的账户，剔除了资产规模低于某水平的账户而未披露，并纳入了一些没有平衡型授权要求的账户，因为这些账户能提高业绩结果。

This composite, however, consists of only a few of the accounts that met the balanced criterion set by the firm, excludes accounts under a certain asset level without disclosing the fact of their exclusion, and includes accounts that do not have the balanced mandate, because those accounts help increase the investment results.

此外，为取得更好结果，Kilmer 随时间更换组合群中的账户，操纵所纳入的有限账户范围。

In addition, to achieve better results, Kilmer manipulates the narrow range of accounts included in the composite by changing the accounts that make up the composite over time.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Kilmer 在发给潜在客户的宣传材料中歪曲事实、扭曲公司业绩记录，并未作出可澄清展示内容的披露，违反了准则 III(D)。

Comment: Kilmer violated Standard III(D) by misrepresenting the facts in the promotional material sent to prospective clients, distorting his firm’s performance record, and failing to include disclosures that would have clarified the presentation.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 5：业绩计算与仅选取部分账户”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

绩效组合的构建决定比较是否公平。挑选表现最好账户、排除不利时期或改变归因方法却不说明，均可能把选择效果伪装成管理能力；应在一致范围和口径下报告。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-047例 6：更改业绩归因方法
Example 6: Performance Attribution Changes

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 157

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 6：更改业绩归因方法 Example 6: Performance Attribution Changes

Purell 正在审查即将发给客户的季度业绩归因报告。

Purell is reviewing the quarterly performance attribution reports for distribution to clients.

Purell 所在投资管理公司采用由下而上、以基本面为导向的投资过程，寻求通过选股增加价值。

Purell works for an investment management firm with a bottom-up, fundamentals-driven investment process that seeks to add value through stock selection.

其归因方法将每只股票的回报与所属板块回报比较。

The attribution methodology compares each stock’s return with its sector return.

归因报告显示，本季度的增值来自资产配置，而选股对计算所得回报作出了负贡献。

The attribution report indicates that the value added this quarter came from asset allocation and that stock selection contributed negatively to the calculated return.

Purell 尝试数种不同方法后发现，如果先将各股票与所属行业比较，再将影响汇总到板块层面，就能让经理的选股表现看起来更好。

After trying several different approaches, Purell discovers that calculating attribution by comparing each stock with its industry and then rolling the effect to the sector level improves the appearance of the manager’s stock selection activities.

由于归因术语由公司自行定义，而且新结果更能反映所述策略，Purell 建议客户报告采用修订后的方法。

Because the firm defines the attribution terms and the results better reflect the stated strategy, Purell recommends that the client reports should use the revised methodology.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：在未作适当披露的情况下修改归因方法，不符合准则 III(D) 的要求。

Comment: Modifying the attribution methodology without proper disclosure fails to meet the requirements of Standard III(D).

Purell 的建议完全是为了公司利益，让人们认为公司更有能力实现其所述投资策略。

Purell’s recommendation is being done solely for the interest of the firm to improve its perceived ability to meet the stated investment strategy.

这类改变掩盖了公司实际能力的事实。

Such changes obscure the facts regarding the firm’s abilities.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 6：更改业绩归因方法”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

绩效组合的构建决定比较是否公平。挑选表现最好账户、排除不利时期或改变归因方法却不说明，均可能把选择效果伪装成管理能力；应在一致范围和口径下报告。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-048例 7：披露业绩计算方法
Example 7: Performance Calculation Methodology Disclosure

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 157

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 7：披露业绩计算方法 Example 7: Performance Calculation Methodology Disclosure

在为现有客户开发新的报告方案时，业绩分析师 Singh 发现，公司新系统会自动计算时间加权及资金加权回报。

While developing a new reporting package for existing clients, Singh, a performance analyst, discovers that her company’s new system automatically calculates both time-weighted and money-weighted returns.

鉴于公司有多种投资策略，包括债券、股票、无杠杆证券及另类投资，她询问客户服务与保留部门负责人，偏好使用哪一种回报类型。

She asks the head of client services and retention which return type is preferred given that the firm has various investment strategies that include bonds, equities, securities without leverage, and alternatives.

对方要求 Singh 不要标明回报类型，以便公司可以展示当期回报最高的计算结果。

Singh is told not to label the returns so that the firm may show whichever performance calculation provides the highest return for the period.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：遵循这些指示将使 Singh 违反准则 III(D)。

Comment: Following these instructions would lead to Singh violating Standard III(D).

如果报告中使用不一致的回报类型，Singh 就没有向公司客户提供完整信息。

In reporting inconsistent return types, Singh would not be providing complete information to the firm’s clients.

只有当客户掌握足够信息，能够判断公司创造的业绩时，才算提供了完整信息。

Complete information is provided when clients have sufficient information to judge the performance generated by the firm.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 7：披露业绩计算方法”应放在准则 III(D) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-CA-049例 1：掌握机密信息
Example 1: Possessing Confidential Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 160

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 1：掌握机密信息 Example 1: Possessing Confidential Information

Connor 是 Johnson Investment Counselors, Inc. 的金融分析师，向 City Medical Center 的受托人提供投资建议。

Connor, a financial analyst employed by Johnson Investment Counselors, Inc., provides investment advice to the trustees of City Medical Center.

受托人向她提供了多份内部报告，涉及 City Medical 的建筑设施翻新及扩建需求。

The trustees have given her a number of internal reports concerning City Medical’s needs for physical plant renovation and expansion.

他们要求 Connor 推荐能使捐赠基金实现资本增值的投资，以满足预计资本开支。

They have asked Connor to recommend investments that would generate capital appreciation in endowment funds to meet projected capital expenditures.

当地商人 Kasey 联系 Connor；他正在考虑向 City Medical Center 或另一家当地医院作出大额捐赠。

Connor is approached by a local businessman, Kasey, who is considering a substantial contribution either to City Medical Center or to another local hospital.

Kasey 希望在决定前了解两家机构的建设计划，但不想与受托人交谈。

Kasey wants to find out the building plans of both institutions before making a decision, but he does not want to speak to the trustees.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：受托人提供内部报告，是为了让 Connor 就捐赠基金的管理提供意见。

Comment: The trustees gave Connor the internal reports so she could advise them on how to manage their endowment funds.

报告中的信息显然具有机密性，而且属于保密关系的范围，因此准则 III(E) 禁止 Connor 向 Kasey 泄露这些信息。

Because the information in the reports is clearly both confidential and within the scope of the confidential relationship, Standard III(E) prohibits Connor from divulging the information to Kasey.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 1：掌握机密信息”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(E) — 保守机密 / Preservation of Confidentiality

相关边界：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-CA-050例 2：披露机密信息
Example 2: Disclosing Confidential Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 160

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 2：披露机密信息 Example 2: Disclosing Confidential Information

Moody 是 Lester Trust Company 的投资经理。

Moody is an investment officer at the Lester Trust Company.

她的一位顾问客户曾与她讨论，拟捐约 50,000 美元给慈善机构，以减少所得税。

She has an advisory client who has talked to her about giving approximately US$50,000 to charity to reduce her income taxes.

Moody 同时担任 Home for Indigent Widows（HIW）的财务主管，该机构正筹备年度募捐活动。

Moody is also treasurer of the Home for Indigent Widows (HIW), which is planning its annual giving campaign.

HIW 希望扩大捐赠者名单，尤其希望增加有能力作出大额捐赠的人士。

HIW hopes to expand its list of donors, particularly those capable of substantial gifts.

Moody 建议 HIW 负责企业捐赠的副总裁拜访其客户，并请求约 50,000 美元的捐款。

Moody recommends that HIW’s vice president for corporate gifts call on her client and ask for a donation in the US$50,000 range.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：虽然协助 Home for Indigent Widows 的动机良好，但 Moody 泄露了客户机密信息，违反了准则 III(E)。

Comment: Even though the attempt to help the Home for Indigent Widows was well intended, Moody violated Standard III(E) by revealing confidential information about her client.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 2：披露机密信息”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

礼品和关系往来应按接受者的决策角色评估。如果提供好处的人正在争取交易、经理遴选或业务，合理观察者可能怀疑判断被影响；应审查好处的价值、频率、时点与独立审批。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(E) — 保守机密 / Preservation of Confidentiality

相关边界：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-CA-051例 3：披露可能的非法活动
Example 3: Disclosing Possible Illegal Activity

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 161

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 3：披露可能的非法活动 Example 3: Disclosing Possible Illegal Activity

Samuel 是 Garcia Company 养老金计划的投资组合经理。她从 Garcia 一位公司高管处得知，Garcia 的首席执行官可能向养老金计划收取过高及不当费用。

Samuel, the portfolio manager for Garcia Company’s pension plan, has learned from one of Garcia’s corporate officers that potentially excessive and improper charges were being made to the pension plan by the CEO of Garcia.

该高管告知她，Garcia 的公司报税表正在接受审计，养老金也正在被审查。

They tell her that Garcia’s corporate tax returns are being audited and the pension fund is being reviewed.

Samuel 咨询雇主的总法律顾问，获告知 Garcia 很可能违反了税务及信义责任方面的法律法规。

Samuel consults her employer’s general counsel and is advised that Garcia likely violated tax and fiduciary regulations and laws.

两天后，政府官员联系 Samuel，要求检查养老金记录。

Two days later, government officials contact Samuel with a request to examine pension fund records.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Samuel 及其雇主应寻求法律顾问意见，确定应采取哪些适当措施，以保护养老金计划参与者及受益人的利益，并遵守回应政府监管机构的适用法律。

Comment: Samuel and her employer should seek the advice of legal counsel to determine the appropriate steps to take to protect the interests of the participants and beneficiaries of the pension plan and comply with applicable law for responding to government regulators.

Samuel 很可能有义务向政府提供公司持有的养老金记录。

Samuel may well have a duty to provide the pension fund records her firm possesses to the government.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 3：披露可能的非法活动”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

涉及可能违法行为时，先查适用法律是否允许或要求披露，再确定披露对象和范围。不能把准则中的例外理解为可向任何人公开全部资料；法律顾问与合规部门可以帮助界定边界。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(E) — 保守机密 / Preservation of Confidentiality

相关边界：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-CA-052例 4：披露可能的非法活动
Example 4: Disclosing Possible Illegal Activity

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 161

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 4：披露可能的非法活动 Example 4: Disclosing Possible Illegal Activity

Bradford 为一家家族房地产开发公司管理资金。

Bradford manages money for a family-owned real estate development corporation.

他也管理数位家族成员及公司高管的个人投资组合，包括首席财务官（CFO）的组合。

He also manages the individual portfolios of several of the family members and officers of the corporation, including the chief financial officer (CFO).

根据公司财务记录，以及他观察到的首席财务官某些可疑做法，Bradford 认为该财务官正在挪用公司资金，存入个人投资账户。

Based on the financial records of the corporation and some questionable practices of the CFO that Bradford has observed, Bradford believes that the CFO is embezzling money from the corporation and putting it into his personal investment account.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Bradford 应咨询公司合规部门或适当法律顾问，确定适用证券法规是否要求向当局报告该首席财务官的财务记录。

Comment: Bradford should check with his firm’s compliance department or appropriate legal counsel to determine whether applicable securities regulations require reporting the CFO’s financial records to authorities.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 4：披露可能的非法活动”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

涉及可能违法行为时，先查适用法律是否允许或要求披露，再确定披露对象和范围。不能把准则中的例外理解为可向任何人公开全部资料；法律顾问与合规部门可以帮助界定边界。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-CA-053例 5：意外披露机密信息
Example 5: Accidental Disclosure of Confidential Information

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 161

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 5：意外披露机密信息 Example 5: Accidental Disclosure of Confidential Information

Moody 是 Lester Trust Company（LTC）的投资经理。

Moody is an investment officer at the Lester Trust Company (LTC).

她负责管理大量独立管理的应税账户。

She has stewardship of a significant number of individually managed taxable accounts.

约十多位高净值人士向 Moody 表示，除了每季度书面报告外，也愿意通过社交媒体直接接收她有关整体经济及金融市场展望的信息。

In addition to receiving quarterly written reports, about a dozen high-net-worth individuals have indicated to Moody a willingness to receive communications about overall economic and financial market outlooks directly from her through social media.

在公司技术及合规部门指导下，她在现有 LTC 社交媒体平台上建立了专供其客户使用的新群组页面。

Under the direction of her firm’s technology and compliance departments, she establishes a new group page on an existing LTC social media platform specifically for her clients.

在向客户提供的说明中，Moody 要求他们“加入”群组，以取得访问所发布内容的权限。

In the instructions provided to clients, Moody asks them to “join” the group so they may be granted access to the posted content.

说明还告知客户，该平台并非传达个人或机密信息的适当渠道。

The instructions also advise clients that the platform is not an appropriate method for communicating personal or confidential information.

六个月后的一月初，Moody 发布 LTC 的年末《市场展望》。

Six months later, in early January, Moody posts LTC’s year-end “Market Outlook.”

报告概述了公司将在新一年加入推荐范围的新资产配置策略。

The report outlines a new asset allocation strategy that the firm is adding to its recommendations in the new year.

Moody 在报告中表示，将在即将举行的会面中，分别与客户讨论这些变化。

In the report, Moody indicates that she will be discussing the changes with clients individually in their upcoming meetings.

Moody 的一位客户直接在群组页面回复，说其家庭财务状况最近发生重大变化。

One of Moody’s clients responds directly on the group page that his family recently experienced a major change in their financial profile.

客户详细描述了该事件中高度私密及机密的信息。

The client describes highly personal and confidential details of the event.

遗憾的是，在 Moody 将评论删除之前，群组内所有客户都能够阅读这些详细内容。

Unfortunately, all clients that were part of the group are also able to read the detailed posting until Moody has the comment removed.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Moody 已采取合理措施，在使用社交媒体平台的同时保护客户信息的机密性。

Comment: Moody has taken reasonable steps to protect the confidentiality of client information while using the social media platform.

她已提供说明，明确指出网站发布的所有信息会向所有群组成员显示，并警告不要通过这种方式传达机密信息。

She provided instructions clarifying that all information posted on the site would be publicly viewable to all group members and warned against using this method for communicating confidential information.

客户意外披露机密信息，不在 Moody 的控制之下。

The accidental disclosure of confidential information by a client is not under Moody’s control.

她在发现后及时删除信息的行动，也进一步符合准则 III(E)。

Her actions to remove the information promptly once she became aware further align with Standard III(E).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 5：意外披露机密信息”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

保密问题不仅来自故意泄露，也可能来自邮件误发、公开场合讨论或不当存储。发现后应限制扩散、通知合规并补救，同时改进访问权限与传输流程。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-CA-054例 6：弱势投资者
Example 6: Vulnerable Investor

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 162

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 6：弱势投资者 Example 6: Vulnerable Investor

财务顾问 Gonzales 向多位私人财富客户提供投资建议。

Gonzales, a financial adviser, provides investment advice to a number of private wealth clients.

在所有客户安排开始时，Gonzales 都将指定第二联系人作为开户流程的一部分；如果她担心客户作出明智财务决定的能力，便可联系该人士。

At the beginning of all client arrangements, as a part of the onboarding process, Gonzales requires the client to designate a secondary contact who Gonzales can communicate with should she become concerned about the client’s ability to make judicious financial decisions.

Gonzales 定期会见长期客户 Brennan，讨论其投资组合；Brennan 是一位寡妇。

Gonzales meets with a longtime client, Brennan, a widow, on a regular basis to discuss her portfolio.

Brennan 已指定儿子为她认知能力下降时的联系人。

Brennan has named her son as the person to contact in the event of her mental decline.

过去几个月，Brennan 忘记了最近三次会面，不得不重新安排后续会面，因此 Gonzales 越来越担心她的认知能力。

Gonzales has growing concerns about Brennan’s mental capacity over the past several months because Brennan has forgotten the last three meetings and has had to reschedule follow-up meetings.

在这些会面中，Brennan 不仅对 Gonzales 知道她过去很容易理解的例行事项表现困惑，而且似乎连长期既定的投资目标也不清楚。

At those meetings, Brennan not only seems confused by routine matters that Gonzales knows she easily grasped in the past but also seems unclear about her long-established investment objectives.

Gonzales 试图轻描淡写地化解这些疏漏时，Brennan 却一反常态地对她表现烦躁。

When Gonzales tries to make light of these lapses, Brennan grows uncharacteristically irritable with her.

Gonzales 在档案中详细记录了这些会面及互动。

Gonzales details these meetings and interactions in her files.

下一次会面时，Brennan 指示 Gonzales 变现其投资组合的 50%。

At the next meeting, Brennan directs Gonzales to liquidate 50% of her portfolio.

Brennan 告诉 Gonzales，她想将这笔资金投入其物理治疗师即将开设的一项高度投机性的私人健身会所业务。

Brennan informs Gonzales that she wishes to invest that money in a highly speculative private health club venture being opened by her physical therapist.

Gonzales 与 Brennan 共事多年，而 Brennan 一向偏好广泛分散的投资组合。

Gonzales has been working with Brennan over many years, and she has always favored a widely diversified portfolio.

在执行 Brennan 的指示之前，Gonzales 联系了她的儿子，讨论相关情况。

Prior to acting on Brennan’s directive, Gonzales contacts her client’s son to discuss this situation with him.

她在 Brennan 的档案中记录了与 Brennan 及其儿子的谈话，以及披露机密信息的理由。

She documents in Brennan’s file the conversation with both Brennan and her son and her reasons for disclosing confidential information.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Gonzales 披露自己对客户可能处于弱势的顾虑，是保护 Brennan 利益的适当措施。

Comment: Gonzales has taken the appropriate steps to protect Brennan’s interests by disclosing her concerns about the vulnerability of her client.

Brennan 之前已表示，如果对其认知能力出现顾虑，Gonzales 应联系其儿子。

Brennan previously indicated that in the event of concerns about her mental capacity, Gonzales should contact her son.

Gonzales 观察到 Brennan 认知能力下降，并担忧她对物理治疗师存在依赖关系，这些都是质疑突然变现大部分投资指示的合理理由。

Gonzales’s observation of Brennan’s mental decline and concern over the dependent relationship with her physical therapist are valid reasons to question the sudden instruction to liquidate a large portion of her investments.

因此，Gonzales 没有违反准则 III(E)“保守机密”。

Gonzales is thus not in violation of the Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 6：弱势投资者”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

当客户可能受诈骗或认知能力下降时，保护客户与保密之间可能存在张力。应先遵循法律、公司程序和有效授权的联系人安排，不能简单把全部账户资料交给未经授权的亲属。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(E) — 保守机密 / Preservation of Confidentiality

相关边界：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-CA-055例 7：向家人披露机密信息
Example 7: Confidential Information to Family Members

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 162-163

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 7：向家人披露机密信息 Example 7: Confidential Information to Family Members

理财规划师 Smith-Pelley 接到长期客户 Carlson 的电话。Carlson 说，她最近与结婚 37 年的丈夫离婚，在国外度假时认识并嫁给了一名比她年轻 25 岁的男子。

Smith-Pelley, a financial planner, receives a call from longtime client, Carlson, who shares the news that, after a recent divorce from her husband of 37 years, she met and married a man 25 years her junior while on a holiday in another country.

该男子是当地公民，但将与 Carlson 一起搬回她的居住地。

The man is a citizen of that country but will be moving home with Carlson.

Carlson 要求 Smith-Pelley 变现其投资账户的一半，以便搬离公寓，与新丈夫搬入昂贵的乡间庄园。

Carlson asks Smith-Pelley to liquidate half of her investment account so she can move out of her flat and into an expensive country estate with her new husband.

Carlson 还指示 Smith-Pelley，将新丈夫的姓名加入所有投资账户文件。

Carlson also directs Smith-Pelley to add her new husband’s name to all her investment account documents.

Carlson 按照指示办理。〔原文如此；按上下文应指顾问 Smith-Pelley 执行指示。〕在接下来六个月，账户不断被提取更多资金，大部分由 Carlson 的新丈夫提取。

Carlson does as directed. Over the next six months, more funds are withdrawn from the account, mostly by Carlson’s new husband.

Carlson 与前夫所生子女也是 Smith-Pelley 的客户。他们联系他，要求冻结母亲账户，声称母亲的认知能力已下降，并正被新伴侣利用。

Carlson’s children from her first marriage, also clients of Smith-Pelley, contact him to demand that their mother’s accounts be frozen, claiming she has diminished mental capacity and is being taken advantage of by the new man in her life.

Smith-Pelley 没有采取行动，并拒绝与子女讨论 Carlson 的账户。

Smith-Pelley does nothing and refuses to discuss Carlson’s accounts with her children.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Smith-Pelley 没有按照 Carlson 子女的指示行动，也没有同他们讨论她的账户，并未违反其道德义务。

Comment: Smith-Pelley is not in violation of his ethical duties by failing to act on Carlson’s children’s directions or discussing her account with them.

虽然 Carlson 最近的决定突然且出人意料，可能引起警觉，但并不表明她丧失了决策能力。

Although Carlson’s recent decisions may raise red flags because the changes were sudden and unexpected, they do not indicate a loss of Carlson’s decision-making ability.

因此，他为客户利益服务、遵循她的指示，并对其投资信息保密，是正确的做法。

As such, he is right to act for the benefit of his client, follow her direction, and keep her investment information confidential.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 7：向家人披露机密信息”应放在准则 III(E) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

家属关系需要进一步问“谁是受益人、是否是正常收费客户、是否使用非公开交易信息”。正常客户家属账户应公平对待；自己拥有受益权的账户则必须服从客户交易优先。

当客户可能受诈骗或认知能力下降时，保护客户与保密之间可能存在张力。应先遵循法律、公司程序和有效授权的联系人安排，不能简单把全部账户资料交给未经授权的亲属。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(E) — 保守机密 / Preservation of Confidentiality

相关边界：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

V10-M05-PR-001课后习题 1
Practice Problem 1

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 164, 168

题目与资料 / Question and data

1. 证券公司的研究分析师 Smith 决定，将 Green Company, Inc. 普通股的建议由“买入”改为“卖出”。

1. Smith, a research analyst with a brokerage firm, decides to change his recommendation for the common stock of Green Company, Inc., from a “buy” to a “sell.”

星期三，他将这项投资建议变更邮寄给公司所有客户。

He mails this change in investment advice to all the firm’s clients on Wednesday.

寄出后的翌日，一位客户来电，要求买入 500 股 Green Company 股票。

The day after the mailing, a client calls with a buy order for 500 shares of Green Company.

在此情况下，Smith 应：

In this circumstance, Smith should:

A. 接受订单。

A. accept the order.

B. 在接受订单之前，告知客户建议已变更。

B. advise the customer of the change in recommendation before accepting the order.

C. 因订单违背公司建议而拒绝接受。

C. not accept the order because it is contrary to the firm’s recommendation.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

1. 正确答案为 B。本题涉及准则 III(B)“公平对待”。

1. The correct answer is B. This question involves Standard III(B) Fair Dealing.

Smith 已向客户发送股票建议变更，但随后收到一位可能尚未收到新建议的客户提出相反的交易要求。

Smith disseminated a change in the stock recommendation to his clients but then received a request contrary to that recommendation from a client who probably had not yet received the recommendation.

在执行订单之前，Smith 应采取额外措施，确保客户已经收到变更后的建议。

Prior to executing the order, Smith should take additional steps to ensure that the customer has received the change of recommendation.

A 不正确，因为客户在收到建议之前下单，因此未能参考 Smith 最新的建议。

Answer A is incorrect because the client placed the order prior to receiving the recommendation and, therefore, does not have the benefit of Smith’s most recent recommendation.

C 也不正确；客户的要求仅因与公司建议相反，并不意味着会员可以否决客户的直接指令。

Answer C is also incorrect; simply because the client request is contrary to the firm’s recommendation does not mean a member can override a direct request by a client.

Smith 联系客户并确认其已收到变更后的建议之后，如果客户仍希望下单买入，Smith 有义务遵从客户指示。

After Smith contacts the client to ensure that the client has received the changed recommendation, if the client still wants to place a buy order for the shares, Smith is obligated to comply with the client’s directive.

参见准则 III(B)：公平对待。

See Standard III(B): Fair Dealing

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(B)（公平对待）。

规则如何作用于本题：公平意味着在建议分发、交易机会和分配规则上采用合理、一贯且透明的程序。客户可有不同收费和服务等级，但不能让某些客户不当地抢先获益或牺牲其他客户。

推理顺序：先看哪些客户适合这项建议或交易，再检查通知时点、分配方法、部分成交和最小交易单位规则。稀缺IPO或交易机会应按预先合理的办法分配。

为什么容易选错：公平不等于每个账户得到相同股数、完全相同服务或同一秒收到信息。差异服务应公开提供，不能损害其他客户的公平机会。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(B) — 公平对待 / Fair Dealing

相关边界：公平不等于每个账户得到相同股数、完全相同服务或同一秒收到信息。差异服务应公开提供，不能损害其他客户的公平机会。

V10-M05-PR-002课后习题 2
Practice Problem 2

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 164, 168

题目与资料 / Question and data

2. 以下哪项有关经理使用客户经纪佣金的说法，违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》？

2. Which statement about a manager’s use of client brokerage commissions violates the Code and Standards?

A. 客户可以指示经理，使用该客户的经纪佣金，为该客户购买商品及服务。

A. A client may direct a manager to use that client’s brokerage commissions to purchase goods and services for that client.

B. 客户经纪佣金应使客户受益，且金额应与取得的经纪及研究服务价值相称。

B. Client brokerage commissions should be used to benefit the client and should be commensurate with the value of the brokerage and research services received.

C. 客户经纪佣金可以用于支付投资经理的运营费用。

C. Client brokerage commissions may be directed to pay for the investment manager’s operating expenses.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

2. 正确答案为 C。本题涉及准则 III(A)“忠诚、审慎与谨慎”，具体是软美元或软佣金问题。

2. The correct answer is C. This question involves Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care and the specific topic of soft dollars or soft commissions.

C 正确，因为客户的经纪佣金不得用于支付投资经理的运营费用。

Answer C is the correct choice because client brokerage commissions may not be directed to pay for the investment manager’s operating expenses.

B 描述会员与考生应如何决定经纪佣金的用途，即该用途是否符合客户最佳利益，以及是否与所提供服务的价值相称。

Answer B describes how members and candidates should determine how to use brokerage commissions—that is, if the use is in the best interests of clients and is commensurate with the value of the services provided.

A 描述的做法通常称为“指定经纪安排”。

Answer A describes a practice that is commonly referred to as “directed brokerage.”

由于经纪佣金是客户的资产，并用于惠及客户而非经理，这种做法不违反对客户的忠诚义务。

Because brokerage is an asset of the client and is used to benefit the client, not the manager, such practice does not violate a duty of loyalty to the client.

会员与考生在任何情况下，都有义务向客户披露使用客户经纪佣金的做法。

Members and candidates are obligated in all situations to disclose to clients their practices in the use of client brokerage commissions.

参见准则 III(A)：忠诚、审慎与谨慎。

See Standard III(A): Loyalty, Prudence, and Care

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

正确选项为 C。需要依据题干已给出的行为、角色与时间顺序作出判断。

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(A)（忠诚、审慎与关怀）。

规则如何作用于本题：客户利益优先于雇主和个人利益。先正确识别客户是谁，再判断交易、佣金、托管和代理安排是否服务于该客户及其受益人。

客户佣金实质上是客户资产。分析时要追踪佣金购买了什么、谁得到好处、是否改善该客户的投资决策或执行；用它交换雇主广告、办公室或个人好处，不能因客户看不到费用而合理化。

推理顺序：养老金等安排通常需要关注计划参与者和受益人。使用客户佣金应能为客户带来合理投资服务价值，并尽力取得最佳执行，而非交换个人或公司其他好处。

为什么容易选错：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(A) — 忠诚、审慎与关怀 / Loyalty, Prudence, and Care

相关边界：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

V10-M05-PR-003课后习题 3
Practice Problem 3

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 164, 168

题目与资料 / Question and data

3. Bronson 向某私立大学捐赠基金的受托人董事会提供投资建议。

3. Bronson provides investment advice to the board of trustees of a private university endowment fund.

受托人向 Bronson 提供了基金财务信息，包括计划开支。

The trustees have provided Bronson with the fund’s financial information, including planned expenditures.

星期五下午，Bronson 接到知名校友 Murdock 的电话，要求他传真基金的全面财务信息。

Bronson receives a phone call on Friday afternoon from Murdock, a prominent alumnus, requesting that Bronson fax him comprehensive financial information about the fund.

Murdock 称自己找到一位潜在捐赠者，但需要当天取得资料才能敲定捐赠，而且无法联系到任何受托人。

According to Murdock, he has a potential contributor but needs the information that day to close the deal and cannot contact any of the trustees.

根据 CFA 协会准则，Bronson 应：

Based on the CFA Institute Standards, Bronson should:

A. 将信息发送给 Murdock，因为披露有利于客户。

A. send Murdock the information because disclosure would benefit the client.

B. 不向 Murdock 发送信息，以保守机密。

B. not send Murdock the information, to preserve confidentiality.

C. 向 Murdock 发送信息，但须及时通知受托人。

C. send Murdock the information, provided Bronson promptly notifies the trustees.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

3. 正确答案为 B。本题涉及准则 III(A)“忠诚、审慎与谨慎”及准则 III(E)“保守机密”。

3. The correct answer is B. This question relates to Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care and Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality.

本例中，会员管理的是私人捐赠基金。

In this case, the member manages funds of a private endowment.

客户，在这里即基金受托人，必须对会员与考生给予一定信任。

Clients—in this case, the trustees of the fund—must place some trust in members and candidates.

无论披露是否可能使基金受益，未经基金许可，Bronson 均不得向任何人披露机密财务信息。

Bronson cannot disclose confidential financial information to anyone without the permission of the fund, regardless of whether the disclosure may benefit the fund.

因此，A 不正确。C 不正确，因为 Bronson 必须在公开信息之前通知基金，并取得基金许可。

Therefore, answer A is incorrect. Answer C is incorrect because Bronson must notify the fund and obtain the fund’s permission before publicizing the information.

参见准则 III(A)：忠诚、审慎与谨慎，以及准则 III(E)：保守机密。

See Standard III(A): Loyalty, Prudence, and Care and Standard III(E): Preservation of Confidentiality

为什么容易选错：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

V10-M05-PR-004课后习题 4
Practice Problem 4

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 164, 168

题目与资料 / Question and data

4. 作出新的投资建议时，以下哪项行动有助于确保证券公司客户得到公平对待？

4. Which one of the following actions will help ensure the fair treatment of brokerage firm clients when a new investment recommendation is made?

A. 事先通知公司所有人员，某项建议即将发布。

A. Informing all people in the firm in advance that a recommendation is to be disseminated

B. 先向机构客户分发建议，再向个人账户分发。

B. Distributing recommendations to institutional clients prior to individual accounts

C. 尽量缩短作出建议决定至发布建议之间的时间。

C. Minimizing the time between the decision and the dissemination of a recommendation

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

4. 正确答案为 C。本题涉及准则 III(B)“公平对待”，考查有助于会员与考生在作出投资建议时公平对待客户的程序。

4. The correct answer is C. This question, which relates to Standard III(B) Fair Dealing, tests the knowledge of the procedures that will assist members and candidates in treating clients fairly when making investment recommendations.

C 所列措施有助于确保客户受到公平对待。

The step listed in C will help ensure the fair treatment of clients.

A 可能对公平对待客户产生负面影响。

Answer A may have negative effects on the fair treatment of clients.

知道即将更改建议的人越多，就越可能有人在正式发布之前通知部分客户。

The more people who know about a pending change, the greater the chance that someone will inform some clients before the information’s release.

公司应制定政策，限制提前知道某项建议即将发布的人数。

The firm should establish policies that limit the number of people who are aware in advance that a recommendation is to be disseminated.

B，即先向机构客户分发建议，再向个人账户分发，是根据资产规模及类别歧视客户，违反了准则 III(B)。

Answer B, distributing recommendations to institutional clients before distributing them to individual accounts, discriminates among clients on the basis of size and class of assets and is a violation of Standard III(B).

参见准则 III(B)：公平对待。

See Standard III(B): Fair Dealing

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(B)（公平对待）。

规则如何作用于本题：公平意味着在建议分发、交易机会和分配规则上采用合理、一贯且透明的程序。客户可有不同收费和服务等级，但不能让某些客户不当地抢先获益或牺牲其他客户。

推理顺序：先看哪些客户适合这项建议或交易，再检查通知时点、分配方法、部分成交和最小交易单位规则。稀缺IPO或交易机会应按预先合理的办法分配。

为什么容易选错：公平不等于每个账户得到相同股数、完全相同服务或同一秒收到信息。差异服务应公开提供，不能损害其他客户的公平机会。

V10-M05-PR-005课后习题 5
Practice Problem 5

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 165, 169

题目与资料 / Question and data

5. Farnsworth 管理的全权委托账户之一，是 Jones Corporation 的员工利润分享计划。

5. One of the discretionary accounts managed by Farnsworth is the Jones Corporation employee profit-sharing plan.

公司总裁 Jones 最近要求 Farnsworth，利用利润分享计划所持股份投票，支持 Jones Corporation 提名的董事名单，并反对异议股东团体支持的董事。

Jones, the company president, recently asked Farnsworth to vote the shares in the profit-sharing plan in favor of the slate of directors nominated by Jones Corporation and against the directors sponsored by a dissident stockholder group.

Farnsworth 不想失去这个账户，因为他将该账户的所有交易交给一家证券公司，而该公司向他提供有关免税投资的有用信息。

Farnsworth does not want to lose this account, because he directs all the account’s trades to a brokerage firm that provides Farnsworth with useful information about tax-free investments.

这些信息虽然无助于管理 Jones Corporation 的账户，却有助于管理其他几个账户。

Although this information is not of value in managing the Jones Corporation account, it does help in managing several other accounts.

提供信息的证券公司还收取最低的交易佣金，并提供最佳执行。

The brokerage firm providing this information also offers the lowest commissions for trades and provides best execution.

Farnsworth 调查了董事选举问题，认为管理层提名的名单较异议团体的名单更有利于公司的长期表现，并据此投票。

Farnsworth investigates the director issue, concludes that the management-nominated slate is better for the long-run performance of the company than the dissident group’s slate, and votes accordingly.

Farnsworth：

Farnsworth:

A. 按 Jones 要求投票违反了准则，但将交易交给该证券公司并未违规。

A. violated the Standards in voting the shares in the manner requested by Jones but not in directing trades to the brokerage firm.

B. 按 Jones 要求投票以及将交易交给该证券公司，两者均未违反准则。

B. did not violate the Standards in voting the shares in the manner requested by Jones or in directing trades to the brokerage firm.

C. 将交易交给该证券公司违反了准则，但按 Jones 要求投票并未违规。

C. violated the Standards in directing trades to the brokerage firm but not in voting the shares as requested by Jones.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

5. 正确答案为 B。本题涉及准则 III(A)“忠诚、审慎与谨慎”，具体是会员或考生在代理投票及客户佣金使用方面的责任。

5. The correct answer is B. This question relates to Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care—specifically, a member’s or candidate’s responsibility for voting proxies and the use of client brokerage.

根据题目所述事实，Farnsworth 没有违反准则 III(A)。

According to the facts stated in the question, Farnsworth did not violate Standard III(A).

虽然公司总裁要求 Farnsworth 按特定方式为 Jones Corporation 利润分享计划所持股份投票，但 Farnsworth 调查了议题，并独立判断出最佳投票方式。

Although the company president asked Farnsworth to vote the shares of the Jones Corporation profit-sharing plan a certain way, Farnsworth investigated the issue and concluded, independently, the best way to vote.

因此，即使他的决定恰与公司总裁的意愿一致，也没有违反对客户忠诚及谨慎的责任。

Therefore, even though his decision coincided with the wishes of the company president, Farnsworth is not in violation of his responsibility to be loyal and to provide care to his clients.

本例中，客户是利润分享计划的参与者及受益人，而非公司管理层。

In this case, the participants and the beneficiaries of the profit-sharing plan are the clients, not the company’s management.

如果 Farnsworth 没有调查问题，或者屈从总裁意愿，投票支持他已判断不符合公司最佳利益的董事名单，便会违反对计划受益人的责任。

Had Farnsworth not investigated the issue or had he yielded to the president’s wishes and voted for a slate of directors that he had determined was not in the best interest of the company, Farnsworth would have violated his responsibilities to the beneficiaries of the plan.

此外，证券公司为证券交易提供最低佣金及最佳执行，因此 Farnsworth 使用该证券公司已履行对客户的义务。

In addition, because the brokerage firm provides the lowest commissions and best execution for securities transactions, Farnsworth has met his obligations to the client in using this brokerage firm.

该证券公司还提供对产生佣金的账户无用的研究信息，并不影响结论，因为 Farnsworth 没有为这些信息额外支付客户资金。

It does not matter that the brokerage firm also provides research information that is not useful for the account generating the commission, because Farnsworth is not paying extra money of the client for that information.

参见准则 III(A)：忠诚、审慎与谨慎。

See Standard III(A): Loyalty, Prudence, and Care

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(A)（忠诚、审慎与关怀）。

规则如何作用于本题：客户利益优先于雇主和个人利益。先正确识别客户是谁，再判断交易、佣金、托管和代理安排是否服务于该客户及其受益人。

推理顺序：养老金等安排通常需要关注计划参与者和受益人。使用客户佣金应能为客户带来合理投资服务价值，并尽力取得最佳执行，而非交换个人或公司其他好处。

为什么容易选错：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

V10-M05-PR-006课后习题 6
Practice Problem 6

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 165, 169

题目与资料 / Question and data

6. Brown 在一家投资顾问公司工作。公司新客户 Green 正首次与 Brown 会面。

6. Brown works for an investment counseling firm. Green, a new client of the firm, is meeting with Brown for the first time.

Green 多年来一直使用另一家顾问公司的财务咨询服务，但现在将账户转到 Brown 的公司。

Green used another counseling firm for financial advice for years, but she has switched her account to Brown’s firm.

花了几分钟相互认识后，Brown 向 Green 解释，自己发现了一只严重低估、潜在收益很大的股票。

After spending a few minutes getting acquainted, Brown explains to Green that she has discovered a highly undervalued stock that offers large potential gains.

她建议 Green 买入该股。Brown 的行为已违反准则。

She recommends that Green purchase the stock. Brown has committed a violation of the Standards.

她本应采取什么不同做法？

What should she have done differently?

A. 在推荐任何类型证券之前，Brown 应先确定 Green 的需求、目标及风险承受能力。

A. Brown should have determined Green’s needs, objectives, and tolerance for risk before making a recommendation of any type of security.

B. Brown 应向 Green 全面解释公司的特征，包括公司所处行业的特点。

B. Brown should have thoroughly explained the characteristics of the company to Green, including the characteristics of the industry in which the company operates.

C. Brown 应解释自己的资格，包括教育、培训、经验，以及 CFA 称号的含义。

C. Brown should have explained her qualifications, including her education, training, and experience and the meaning of the CFA designation.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

6. 正确答案为 A。题中 Brown 尚未了解客户财务状况、投资经验或投资目标，就提出投资建议。

6. The correct answer is A. In this question, Brown is providing investment recommendations before making inquiries about the client’s financial situation, investment experience, or investment objectives.

因此，Brown 违反了准则 III(C)“适当性”。B 和 C 列出了会员与考生在关系开始时应与客户讨论的一些信息，但并不是这些因素的完整清单。

Brown is thus violating Standard III(C) Suitability. Answers B and C provide examples of information members and candidates should discuss with their clients at the outset of the relationship, but these answers do not constitute a complete list of those factors.

A 是最佳答案。参见准则 III(C)：适当性。

Answer A is the best answer. See Standard III(C): Suitability

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(C)（适当性）。

规则如何作用于本题：在提供投资建议前，应合理了解客户的经验、目标、风险承受能力与财务情况，并在整体组合层面评估投资是否适合。管理专门授权组合时还须遵守既定策略或风格。

适当性不能只按单项证券风险判断。应核对客户总资产、负债、目标和既有持仓，说明这笔交易如何改变整体风险；客户目标变化时，旧IPS不能继续作为不更新的借口。

推理顺序：把具体交易放回IPS和全组合风险中看，核查期限、流动性和集中度；客户重要情况变化时及时更新。客户主动提出不合适交易时也要讨论并记录风险。

为什么容易选错：高风险证券并非对所有客户都不适合，低风险证券也并非对所有目标都合适。客户口头同意不能自动消除调查、说明或授权限制。

V10-M05-PR-007课后习题 7
Practice Problem 7

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 165, 169

题目与资料 / Question and data

7. Stewart 受 Goodner Industries, Inc. 聘用，管理其养老金。

7. Stewart has been hired by Goodner Industries, Inc., to manage its pension fund.

Stewart 的忠诚、审慎与谨慎义务，应向谁承担？

Stewart’s duty of loyalty, prudence, and care is owed to:

A. Goodner 管理层。

A. the management of Goodner.

B. Goodner 养老金计划的参与者及受益人。

B. the participants and beneficiaries of Goodner’s pension plan.

C. Goodner 股东。

C. the shareholders of Goodner.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

7. 正确答案为 B。根据准则 III(A)“忠诚、审慎与谨慎”，管理公司养老金的会员与考生，应向养老金计划参与者及受益人承担这些义务，而非向公司管理层或股东承担。

7. The correct answer is B. Under Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care, members and candidates who manage a company’s pension fund owe these duties to the participants and beneficiaries of the pension plan, not the management of the company or the company’s shareholders.

准则 III(A)：忠诚、审慎与谨慎。

Standard III(A): Loyalty, Prudence, and Care

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(A)（忠诚、审慎与关怀）。

规则如何作用于本题：客户利益优先于雇主和个人利益。先正确识别客户是谁，再判断交易、佣金、托管和代理安排是否服务于该客户及其受益人。

推理顺序：养老金等安排通常需要关注计划参与者和受益人。使用客户佣金应能为客户带来合理投资服务价值，并尽力取得最佳执行，而非交换个人或公司其他好处。

为什么容易选错：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

V10-M05-PR-008课后习题 8
Practice Problem 8

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 165-166, 169

题目与资料 / Question and data

8. Carter 在当地资产管理公司 Invest Today 工作。

8. Carter works for Invest Today, a local asset management firm.

一家通过客户佣金安排向 Carter 提供自有研究的经纪商，正推出新的交易服务。

A broker that provides Carter with proprietary research through client brokerage arrangements is offering a new trading service.

该经纪商提供低费用、仅执行交易的服务，作为传统交易执行加研究全套服务的补充。

The broker is offering low-fee, execution-only trades to complement its traditional full-service execution-and-research trades.

为吸引 Carter 及其他资产管理人带来更多业务，经纪商会把新服务产生的佣金计入此前全套服务安排所要求的佣金承诺额。

To entice Carter and other asset managers to send additional business its way, the broker will apply the commissions paid on the new service toward satisfying the brokerage commitment of the prior full-service arrangements.

Carter 一直满意其全套服务交易的执行情况；新低费率交易的费用，也与目前为禁止软佣金安排的账户所使用其他经纪商的费用相当。

Carter has always been satisfied with the execution provided on the full-service trades, and the fees of the new low-fee trades are comparable to those of other brokers currently used for the accounts that prohibit soft dollar arrangements.

A. Carter 可以使用新的低费用交易方案，为禁止软佣金安排的账户交易。

A. Carter can trade for his accounts that prohibit soft dollar arrangements under the new low-fee trading scheme.

B. Carter 不能使用新交易方案，因为这些佣金受账户软佣金限制所禁止。

B. Carter cannot use the new trading scheme because the commissions are prohibited by the soft dollar restrictions of the accounts.

C. Carter 应只通过新的低费用方案交易，并增加交易量，以满足其佣金承诺要求。

C. Carter should trade only through the new low-fee scheme and should increase his trading volume to meet his required commission commitment.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

8. A 正确。本题涉及准则 III(A)“忠诚、审慎与谨慎”。

8. Answer A is correct. The question relates to Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care.

Carter 认为该经纪商的执行有效，费用与其他经纪商相当，因此可以为所有账户使用该经纪商。

Carter believes the broker offers effective execution at a fee that is comparable with those of other brokers, so he is free to use the broker for all accounts.

B 不正确，因为禁止软佣金安排的账户，不希望出资为 Carter 购买研究服务。

Answer B is incorrect because the accounts that prohibit soft dollar arrangements do not want to fund the purchase of research by Carter.

新交易方案不会向客户收取额外佣金，因此不违背该禁令。

The new trading scheme does not incur additional commissions from clients, so it would not go against the prohibitions.

C 不正确，因为 Carter 不应为满足软佣金安排的佣金承诺，对组合进行不必要或过度的频繁买卖，即过度交易。

Answer C is incorrect because Carter should not incur unnecessary or excessive “churning” of the portfolios (excessive trading) for the purpose of meeting the brokerage commitments of soft dollar arrangements.

准则 III(A)：忠诚、审慎与谨慎。

Standard III(A): Loyalty, Prudence, and Care

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

正确选项为 A。需要依据题干已给出的行为、角色与时间顺序作出判断。

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(A)（忠诚、审慎与关怀）。

规则如何作用于本题：客户利益优先于雇主和个人利益。先正确识别客户是谁，再判断交易、佣金、托管和代理安排是否服务于该客户及其受益人。

客户佣金实质上是客户资产。分析时要追踪佣金购买了什么、谁得到好处、是否改善该客户的投资决策或执行；用它交换雇主广告、办公室或个人好处，不能因客户看不到费用而合理化。

交易应有投资依据，而不是为了提高佣金或满足销售目标。即使单笔交易适合客户，过高交易频率也会通过成本和税负损害客户，因此需要在整体账户层面审视。

推理顺序：养老金等安排通常需要关注计划参与者和受益人。使用客户佣金应能为客户带来合理投资服务价值，并尽力取得最佳执行，而非交换个人或公司其他好处。

为什么容易选错：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

V10-M05-PR-009课后习题 9
Practice Problem 9

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 166, 169

题目与资料 / Question and data

9. Stafford 是一只专门投资房地产的共同基金的投资组合经理。

9. Stafford is a portfolio manager for a specialized real estate mutual fund.

公司已在基金招募说明书中清楚说明软佣金政策。

Her firm clearly describes in the fund’s prospectus its soft dollar policies.

Stafford 认为参加 CFA 课程能够提高投资决策能力，因此决定用基金软佣金账户支付 CFA 课程注册费及考试费。

Stafford decides that entering the CFA Program will enhance her investment decision-making skill and decides to use the fund’s soft dollar account to pay the registration and exam fees for the CFA Program.

以下哪项说法最可能正确？

Which of the following statements is most likely correct?

A. Stafford 没有违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》，因为招募说明书已告知投资者基金的软佣金政策。

A. Stafford did not violate the Code and Standards because the prospectus informed investors of the fund’s soft dollar policies.

B. Stafford 违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》，因为提高其投资技能并非软佣金账户的合理用途。

B. Stafford violated the Code and Standards because improving her investment skills is not a reasonable use of the soft dollar account.

C. Stafford 违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》，因为 CFA 课程不符合可以使用经纪佣金购买的研究服务定义。

C. Stafford violated the Code and Standards because the CFA Program does not meet the definition of research allowed to be purchased with brokerage commissions.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

9. C 正确。根据准则 III(A)“忠诚、审慎与谨慎”，CFA 课程费用属于个人或公司开支，不应使用基金的经纪佣金支付。

9. Answer C is correct. According to Standard III(A) Loyalty, Prudence, and Care, the CFA Program would be considered a personal or firm expense and should not be paid for with the fund’s brokerage commissions.

软佣金账户只应用于购买能直接协助投资经理作出投资决策的研究服务，而不应用于协助公司管理或进修教育。

Soft dollar accounts should be used only to purchase research services that directly assist the investment manager in the investment decision-making process, not to assist the management of the firm or to further education.

因此，A 不正确。B 不正确，因为问题不在于资金用途是否合理，而在于教育开支并非研究服务。

Thus, answer A is incorrect. Answer B is incorrect because the reasonableness of how the money is used is not an issue; the issue is that educational expense is not research.

准则 III(A)：忠诚、审慎与谨慎。

Standard III(A): Loyalty, Prudence, and Care

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

正确选项为 C。本题含否定或例外要求，选项应按题干的反向条件判断。

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(A)（忠诚、审慎与关怀）。

规则如何作用于本题：客户利益优先于雇主和个人利益。先正确识别客户是谁，再判断交易、佣金、托管和代理安排是否服务于该客户及其受益人。

客户佣金实质上是客户资产。分析时要追踪佣金购买了什么、谁得到好处、是否改善该客户的投资决策或执行；用它交换雇主广告、办公室或个人好处，不能因客户看不到费用而合理化。

费用必须说明计算基础、适用范围和实际经济负担。把包含加价的收费说成原样转付、只对新客户修正而继续向老客户误导收费，都会保留原有问题。

推理顺序：养老金等安排通常需要关注计划参与者和受益人。使用客户佣金应能为客户带来合理投资服务价值，并尽力取得最佳执行，而非交换个人或公司其他好处。

为什么容易选错：最佳执行不是机械追求最低佣金；质量、价格、速度和整体服务都可能相关。授权交易范围有限时责任须按服务约定界定，但基本诚信责任仍存在。

V10-M05-PR-010课后习题 10
Practice Problem 10

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 166, 170

题目与资料 / Question and data

10. ABC Investment Management 新取得一个非常庞大的账户，其中有两项集中持仓。

10. ABC Investment Management acquires a new, very large account with two concentrated positions.

公司现行政策是，在管理满第一个完整月份之后，才将新账户纳入业绩计算。

The firm’s current policy is to add new accounts for the purpose of performance calculation after the first full month of management.

Cupp 负责计算公司的业绩回报。

Cupp is responsible for calculating the firm’s performance returns.

首个月尚未结束，Cupp 发现新账户一项重要持仓的公司被另一家公司收购，令该投资价值翻倍。

Before the end of the initial month, Cupp notices that one of the significant holdings of the new accounts is acquired by another company, causing the value of the investment to double.

由于这项持仓，Cupp 决定自账户转入之日起就将新组合纳入计算，使 ABC Investment 得以受惠于该组合当月回报的正面影响。

Because of this holding, Cupp decides to account for the new portfolio as of the date of transfer, thereby allowing ABC Investment to reap the positive impact of that month’s portfolio return.

以下哪项说法正确？

Which of the following statements is true?

A. Cupp 没有违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》，因为 GIPS 标准允许在发生大额外部现金流的日期更新组合群。

A. Cupp did not violate the Code and Standards, because the GIPS standards allow composites to be updated on the date of large external cash flows.

B. Cupp 没有违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》，因为公司可以自行决定何时将新账户纳入组合群计算。

B. Cupp did not violate the Code and Standards, because companies are allowed to determine when to incorporate new accounts into their composite calculation.

C. Cupp 违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》，因为按公司已公布的政策，纳入新账户导致当月业绩计算不准确。

C. Cupp violated the Code and Standards because the inclusion of the new account produces an inaccurate calculation of the monthly results according to the firm’s stated policies.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

10. C 正确。Cupp 仅为计入持仓被收购带来的收益，而偏离公司已公布的政策，违反了准则 III(D)“业绩展示”。

10. Answer C is correct. Cupp violated Standard III(D) Performance Presentation when he deviated from the firm’s stated policies solely to capture the gain from the holding being acquired.

A 不正确，因为公司并未声称符合 GIPS 标准，而且 GIPS 要求按照公司书面政策一致处理外部现金流。

Answer A is incorrect because the firm does not claim GIPS compliance and the GIPS standards require external cash flows to be treated in a manner consistent with the firm’s documented policies.

B 不正确，因为公司并未表示正在更新组合群政策。

Answer B is incorrect because the firm does not state that it is updating its composite policies.

如果确实更改政策，就必须审查该月所有现金流，确保按新政策一致处理。

If such a change were to occur, all cash flows for the month would have to be reviewed to ensure their consistent treatment under the new policy.

参见准则 III(D)：业绩展示。

See Standard III(D): Performance Presentation

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

正确选项为 C。本题含否定或例外要求，选项应按题干的反向条件判断。

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(D)（业绩呈现）。

规则如何作用于本题：业绩信息应公平、准确、完整，使读者了解真实结果、期间、方法与限制。不能通过挑账户、挑时期或隐去费用与模拟性质制造优于事实的印象。

推理顺序：检查数据是否覆盖合适账户及期间、计算和权重是否一致、是否包含终止账户、前雇主业绩归属是否说明，及模拟与真实结果是否明确区分。

为什么容易选错：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(D) — 业绩呈现 / Performance Presentation

相关边界：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-PR-011课后习题 11
Practice Problem 11

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 166-167, 170

题目与资料 / Question and data

11. Paper 最近被解雇；他原为某股票基金五人经理团队的成员之一。

11. Paper was recently terminated as one of a team of five managers of an equity fund.

该基金有两名专注价值投资的经理，为降低成本而解雇其中一人。

The fund had two value-focused managers and terminated one of them to reduce costs.

在寄给潜在雇主的信中，Paper 经公司书面许可，展示该基金的历史业绩，以证明自己过去的成功。

In a letter sent to prospective employers, Paper presents, with written permission of the firm, the performance history of the fund to demonstrate his past success.

以下哪项说法正确？

Which of the following statements is true?

A. Paper 没有违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

A. Paper did not violate the Code and Standards.

B. Paper 将整只基金的业绩声称为自己的业绩，违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

B. Paper violated the Code and Standards by claiming the performance of the entire fund as his own.

C. Paper 纳入了前雇主的历史业绩，违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

C. Paper violated the Code and Standards by including the historical results of his prior employer.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

11. B 正确。Paper 没有披露所展示结果由一个经理团队共同取得，而他只是其中一员，因此违反了准则 III(D)“业绩展示”。

11. Answer B is correct. Paper has violated Standard III(D) Performance Presentation by not disclosing that he was part of a team of managers that achieved the results shown.

如果他同时列明自己直接管理部分的回报，就不会违反该准则。

If he had also included the return of the portion he directly managed, he would not have violated the standard.

因此，A 不正确。C 不正确，因为 Paper 已取得前雇主的书面许可，可以列示这些业绩。

Thus, answer A is incorrect. Answer C is incorrect because Paper received written permission from his prior employer to include the results.

参见准则 III(D)：业绩展示。

See Standard III(D): Performance Presentation

Standard III(D) — 业绩呈现 / Performance Presentation

相关边界：不强制所有人使用同一呈现方法，但方法必须诚实且披露足够。GIPS合规是另一项更具体要求；未声称GIPS合规也仍需满足本准则。

V10-M05-PR-012课后习题 12
Practice Problem 12

章末练习 / Practice problem · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 167, 170

题目与资料 / Question and data

12. Townsend 最近获任一个青少年高尔夫项目的董事；该项目是某全国性非营利组织的地方分支。

12. Townsend was recently appointed to the board of directors of a youth golf program that is the local chapter of a national not-for-profit organization.

该项目正开展新一轮筹款活动，以增加每年提供的奖学金数量。

The program is beginning a new fund-raising campaign to expand the number of annual scholarships it provides.

Townsend 相信，她的许多客户每年都作慈善捐款。

Townsend believes many of her clients make annual donations to charity.

下一周，她在发给所有客户的定期通讯中，加入一小段内容，介绍筹款活动及自己在该组织董事会的职务。

The next week in her regular newsletter to all clients, she includes a small section discussing the fund-raising campaign and her position on the organization’s board.

以下哪项说法正确？

Which of the following statements is true?

A. Townsend 没有违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

A. Townsend did not violate the Code and Standards.

B. Townsend 通过通讯向客户募捐，违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

B. Townsend violated the Code and Standards by soliciting donations from her clients through the newsletter.

C. Townsend 未在向客户募捐前取得该组织批准，违反了《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

C. Townsend violated the Code and Standards by not getting approval of the organization before soliciting her clients.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

12. A 正确。Townsend 没有向高尔夫项目的负责人或管理人员提供任何客户信息，因此没有违反准则 III(E)“保守机密”。

12. Answer A is correct. Townsend has not provided any information about her clients to the leaders or managers of the golf program; thus, she has not violated Standard III(E) Preservation of Confidentiality.

如果她提供客户联络资料供直接邮寄募捐使用，就会构成违规。

Providing contact information about her clients for a direct-mail solicitation would have been a violation.

B 不正确，因为通讯中的通知并不违反准则 III(E)。

Answer B is incorrect because the notice in the newsletter does not violate Standard III(E).

C 不正确，因为高尔夫项目的筹款活动已经开始，因此介绍捐赠机会是适当的。

Answer C is incorrect because the golf program’s fund-raising campaign had already begun, so discussing the opportunity to donate was appropriate.

参见准则 III(E)：保守机密。

See Standard III(E): Preservation of Confidentiality

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

正确选项为 A。本题含否定或例外要求，选项应按题干的反向条件判断。

本题的核心判断依据是准则 III(E)（保守机密）。

规则如何作用于本题：对当前、过去和潜在客户的信息通常负有保密义务。可以披露的例外包括客户授权、法律要求，以及在适用法律允许时与客户非法活动相关的情形。

离职的时间线是关键证据。在职时招揽现有客户或使用雇主资源经营竞争业务，与为未来成立公司作一般准备不同；离职后仍要尊重有效保密和非招揽义务。

推理顺序：先确认信息属于谁、谁有权授权、接收人是否合法，以及是否存在明确法定义务。与合规或法律顾问讨论时也要控制不必要的信息扩散。

为什么容易选错：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard III(E) — 保守机密 / Preservation of Confidentiality

相关边界：亲属、朋友或同事不因关系亲近就自动获得访问权；怀疑有问题也不代表可任意公开客户资料。保密义务不会因客户关系终止而自然消失。

LM 6 · 准则 IV 指引：对雇主的责任
Guidance for Standard IV: Duties to Employers
24 条目 · 原题与解析逐条对应 / Paired source questions and explanations

V10-M06-CA-005例 1：招揽现有及潜在客户
Example 1: Soliciting Current Clients and Prospects

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 175-176

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 1：招揽现有及潜在客户 Example 1: Soliciting Current Clients and Prospects

Magee 为 Trust Assets, Inc. 管理养老金账户。他对工作环境感到沮丧，并已获得 Fiduciary Management 的工作邀约。

Magee manages pension accounts for Trust Assets, Inc. He has become frustrated with the working environment and has been offered a position with Fiduciary Management.

在辞去 Trust Assets 工作之前，Magee 要求四个大客户离开该公司，并在 Fiduciary 开立账户。

Before resigning from Trust Assets, Magee asks four big accounts to leave that firm and open accounts with Fiduciary.

Magee 还说服数位潜在客户与 Fiduciary Management 签署协议。

Magee also persuades several prospective clients to sign agreements with Fiduciary Management.

此前，Magee 曾代表 Trust Assets 向这些潜在客户作介绍。

Magee previously made presentations to these prospects on behalf of Trust Assets.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Magee 违反了雇佣关系中要求其完全为雇主利益行事的原则。

Comment: Magee violated the employer–employee principle requiring him to act solely for his employer’s benefit.

只要 Magee 仍受雇于 Trust Assets，他就对该公司负有责任。

Magee’s duty is to Trust Assets as long as he is employed there.

Magee 在仍受雇期间招揽 Trust Assets 的现有及潜在客户，属于不道德行为，并违反准则 IV(A)。

Magee’s solicitation of Trust Assets’ current clients and prospective clients while still employed by the firm is unethical and violates Standard IV(A).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 1：招揽现有及潜在客户”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。

离职的时间线是关键证据。在职时招揽现有客户或使用雇主资源经营竞争业务，与为未来成立公司作一般准备不同；离职后仍要尊重有效保密和非招揽义务。

推理顺序：判断行为发生在离职前还是离职后，使用的材料属于谁，是否有有效协议，以及是否侵占业务或客户名单。可以保有技能和经验，但不能擅自带走雇主财产或机密。

为什么容易选错：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard IV(A) — 对雇主的忠诚 / Loyalty

相关边界：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

V10-M06-CA-006例 2：前雇主的文件及档案
Example 2: Former Employer’s Documents and Files

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 176

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 2：前雇主的文件及档案 Example 2: Former Employer’s Documents and Files

Hightower 已在 Jason Investment Management Corporation 工作 15 年。

Hightower has been employed by Jason Investment Management Corporation for 15 years.

他最初担任分析师，随后承担越来越多职责，目前是高级投资组合经理，并为公司投资政策委员会成员。

He began as an analyst but assumed increasing responsibilities and is now a senior portfolio manager and a member of the firm’s investment policy committee.

Hightower 决定离开 Jason Investment，创办自己的投资管理业务。

Hightower has decided to leave Jason Investment and start his own investment management business.

他一直谨慎地不向 Jason Investment 的任何客户透露离职消息，因为不希望被指控在离职前招揽客户、违反对公司的责任。

He has been careful not to tell any of Jason Investment’s clients that he is leaving; he does not want to be accused of breaching his duty to Jason Investment by soliciting its clients before his departure.

Hightower 计划复制并带走其在 Jason Investment 任职期间开发或参与制作的以下文件和信息：（1）客户名单，包括地址、电话及其他相关客户资料；（2）客户账户报表；（3）向潜在客户展示、包含公司业绩记录的营销演示样本；（4）Jason Investment 的证券推荐名单；（5）为不同目标账户确定资产配置的计算机模型；（6）选股计算机模型；（7）他担任分析师时为主要公司投资建议制作的电子表格。

Hightower is planning to copy and take with him the following documents and information he developed or worked on while at Jason Investment: (1) the client list, with addresses, telephone numbers, and other pertinent client information; (2) client account statements; (3) sample marketing presentations to prospective clients containing the firm’s performance record; (4) Jason Investment’s recommended list of securities; (5) computer models to determine asset allocations for accounts with various objectives; (6) computer models for stock selection; and (7) spreadsheets for Hightower’s major corporate recommendations, which he developed when he was an analyst.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：除非取得雇主同意，离职的会员与考生不得带走雇主财产，包括账簿、记录、报告及其他资料，因为带走这些材料可能影响雇主的业务机会。

Comment: Except with the consent of their employer, departing members and candidates may not take employer property, which includes books, records, reports, and other materials, because taking such materials may interfere with their employer’s business opportunities.

带走任何雇主记录，即使记录由会员或考生本人制作，也违反准则 IV(A)。

Taking any employer records, even those the member or candidate prepared, violates Standard IV(A).

雇主记录包括纸质资料，以及存于任何其他媒介的内容，例如家用电脑、便携存储设备及手机。

Employer records include items stored in hard copy or any other medium (e.g., home computers, portable storage devices, cell phones).

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 2：前雇主的文件及档案”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。

个人经验可以随人离职，雇主拥有的研究、客户资料和记录通常不能。若要展示旧业绩或使用旧研究，应有可验证记录、相应授权并准确交代角色和时间，不能把团队/机构成果据为己有。

推理顺序：判断行为发生在离职前还是离职后，使用的材料属于谁，是否有有效协议，以及是否侵占业务或客户名单。可以保有技能和经验，但不能擅自带走雇主财产或机密。

为什么容易选错：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

Standard IV(A) — 对雇主的忠诚 / Loyalty

相关边界：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

V10-M06-CA-007例 3：既往完成工作的所有权
Example 3: Ownership of Completed Prior Work

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 176

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 3：既往完成工作的所有权 Example 3: Ownership of Completed Prior Work

Madeline 刚大学毕业，也是 CFA 课程考生，暑期在 Murdoch and Lowell 担任无薪实习生。

Madeline, a recent college graduate and a candidate in the CFA Program, spends her summer as an unpaid intern at Murdoch and Lowell.

Murdoch 的高级管理人员正努力使公司符合 GIPS® 标准，Madeline 获派协助这项工作。

The senior managers at Murdoch are attempting to bring the firm into compliance with the GIPS® standards, and Madeline is assigned to assist in its efforts.

实习两个月后，Madeline 申请加入也计划遵守 GIPS 标准的 McMillan & Company。

Two months into her internship, Madeline applies for a job at McMillan & Company, which has plans to become GIPS compliant.

Madeline 接受了 McMillan 的工作。离开 Murdoch 前，她复制了自己参与开发的公司软件，因为认为这会帮助她胜任新岗位。

Madeline accepts the job with McMillan. Before leaving Murdoch, she copies the firm’s software that she helped develop because she believes this software will assist her in her new position.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：虽然 Madeline 在 Murdoch 服务期间没有获得金钱报酬，但她使用公司资源开发软件，而且以工作经验和知识形式取得报酬及利益，因此被视为员工。

Comment: Even though Madeline does not receive monetary compensation for her services at Murdoch, she used firm resources in creating the software and is considered an employee because she receives compensation and benefits in the form of work experience and knowledge.

Madeline 未经许可复制软件，侵占了 Murdoch 的财产，违反了准则 IV(A)。

By copying the software, Madeline violated Standard IV(A) because she misappropriated Murdoch’s property without permission.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 3：既往完成工作的所有权”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。

个人经验可以随人离职，雇主拥有的研究、客户资料和记录通常不能。若要展示旧业绩或使用旧研究，应有可验证记录、相应授权并准确交代角色和时间，不能把团队/机构成果据为己有。

推理顺序：判断行为发生在离职前还是离职后，使用的材料属于谁，是否有有效协议，以及是否侵占业务或客户名单。可以保有技能和经验，但不能擅自带走雇主财产或机密。

为什么容易选错：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

V10-M06-CA-008例 4：贬损雇主
Example 4: Disparaging Employer

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 177

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 4：贬损雇主 Example 4: Disparaging Employer

Nash 获一家区域性投资顾问公司聘用，担任服务零售客户的投资顾问。

Nash is hired as an investment adviser working with retail clients for a regional investment advisory firm.

入职不久，Nash 发现公司顾问受到压力，需要在客户账户中频繁买卖投资，以产生费用。

Shortly after starting work, Nash realizes that the advisers at the firm are under pressure to churn investments in client accounts to generate fees.

他先后向直属经理、首席合规官，最终向公司高级管理层反映顾虑。

He brings his concerns to his immediate manager, the chief compliance officer, and ultimately to the senior managers of the firm.

他未能促使公司改变做法，于是在竞争公司找到另一份工作。

He is unsuccessful in getting the firm to change its practices and finds other employment at a competing firm.

提交辞呈后、正式离职前，他按照雇主指示，向自己服务的客户发出通知，告知即将离职，以及他们的账户将转由公司其他投资组合经理负责。

Upon handing in his resignation but prior to leaving his current employer, at the employer’s direction, he sends notice to clients he worked with that he will be leaving the firm and informs them that their accounts will be transferred to other portfolio managers at the firm.

一位客户联系他，进一步询问离职情况。

One of his clients contacts him and inquires more about the circumstances of his departure.

Nash 详细描述公司的不道德做法，向客户提供新雇主的信息，并鼓励她转移账户，跟随自己加入新公司。

Nash describes in detail the unethical practices of his firm, gives the client information about his new employer, and encourages the client to transfer her account and follow Nash to his new firm.

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：Nash 向客户贬损现任雇主，并为未来雇主招揽客户业务，违反了准则 IV(A)。

Comment: Nash violated Standard IV(A) by disparaging his current employer to his client and soliciting her business for his future employer.

即使客户转到新公司会更好，他的行为仍然违规。

His actions are a violation even if the client would be better off at the new firm.

离职后，Nash 可以告知原客户，自己对其所受待遇的顾虑，并建议更换投资经理。

After leaving the firm, Nash can inform his former clients of his concerns about their treatment and suggest they change investment managers.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 4：贬损雇主”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。

离职的时间线是关键证据。在职时招揽现有客户或使用雇主资源经营竞争业务，与为未来成立公司作一般准备不同；离职后仍要尊重有效保密和非招揽义务。

费用必须说明计算基础、适用范围和实际经济负担。把包含加价的收费说成原样转付、只对新客户修正而继续向老客户误导收费，都会保留原有问题。

推理顺序：判断行为发生在离职前还是离职后，使用的材料属于谁，是否有有效协议，以及是否侵占业务或客户名单。可以保有技能和经验，但不能擅自带走雇主财产或机密。

为什么容易选错：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

V10-M06-CA-009例 5：招揽原客户
Example 5: Soliciting Former Clients

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 177

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 5：招揽原客户 Example 5: Soliciting Former Clients

Elliot 聘用了此前在竞争公司工作的 Chisolm。

Elliot has hired Chisolm, who previously worked for a competing firm.

Chisolm 在前公司工作 18 年后离职。

Chisolm left his former firm after 18 years of employment.

开始为 Elliot 工作时，Chisolm 希望联系原客户，因为他非常熟悉他们，并确信许多人会跟随他加入新雇主。

When Chisolm begins working for Elliot, he wants to contact his former clients because he knows them well and is certain that many will follow him to his new employer.

如果 Chisolm 联系原客户，是否违反准则 IV(A)？

Is Chisolm in violation of Standard IV(A) if he contacts his former clients?

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：客户记录是公司财产，因此无论出于何种原因，使用未经许可从前雇主带走的客户名单或其他信息联系原客户，都违反准则 IV(A)。

Comment: Because client records are the property of the firm, contacting former clients for any reason through the use of client lists or other information taken from a former employer without permission is a violation of Standard IV(A).

仅仅知道原客户的姓名及其存在，不属于机密信息，正如员工在任职期间取得的技能或经验不属于“机密”或“受特权保护”的信息一样。

Simple knowledge of the names and existence of former clients is not confidential information, just as skills or experience that an employee obtains while employed are not “confidential” or “privileged” information.

《道德准则与专业行为准则》不禁止将在一位雇主处取得的经验或知识，运用于另一位雇主。

The Code and Standards do not impose a prohibition on the use of experience or knowledge gained at one employer from being used at another employer.

如果没有禁止此类行为的协议，《道德准则与专业行为准则》也不禁止离职员工联系原公司的客户。

The Code and Standards also do not prohibit former employees from contacting clients of their previous firm in the absence of an agreement that prohibits such conduct.

会员与考生离职后，可自由利用与原公司有关的公开信息联系原客户，而不违反准则 IV(A)。

Members and candidates are free to use public information about their former firm after departing to contact former clients without violating Standard IV(A).

如果不存在禁止此类行为的协议，只要 Chisolm 在加入 Elliot 公司之前仍履行对雇主的忠诚义务，在离开原公司之后才开始招揽客户，并在离职后不擅自使用前雇主材料，就不违反《道德准则与专业行为准则》。

In the absence of an agreement that prohibits such conduct, as long as Chisolm maintains his duty of loyalty to his employer before joining Elliot’s firm, does not take steps to solicit clients until he has left his former firm, and does not use material from his former employer without its permission after he has left, he is not in violation of the Code and Standards.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 5：招揽原客户”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。

离职的时间线是关键证据。在职时招揽现有客户或使用雇主资源经营竞争业务，与为未来成立公司作一般准备不同；离职后仍要尊重有效保密和非招揽义务。

推理顺序：判断行为发生在离职前还是离职后，使用的材料属于谁，是否有有效协议，以及是否侵占业务或客户名单。可以保有技能和经验，但不能擅自带走雇主财产或机密。

为什么容易选错：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

相关知识点 / Related concepts

Standard IV(A) — 对雇主的忠诚 / Loyalty

相关边界：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

V10-M06-CA-010例 6：为离职作准备
Example 6: Preparation for Leaving Employer

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 178

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 6：为离职作准备 Example 6: Preparation for Leaving Employer

Allen 目前在一家注册投资公司担任股票分析师。

Allen currently works at a registered investment company as an equity analyst.

她没有通知雇主，便向政府机关登记成立一家将与雇主竞争的投资公司，但尚未寻找客户。

Without notice to her employer, she registers with government authorities to start an investment company that will compete with her employer, but she does not seek clients.

向适当监管机构登记成立这家竞争公司，是否违反准则 IV(A)？

Does registration of this competing company with the appropriate regulatory authorities constitute a violation of Standard IV(A)?

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：如果 Allen 是利用办公室以外的个人时间进行准备，而且在离开现任雇主之前不会为新业务招揽客户或以其他方式经营新公司，那么向监管机构登记筹备新业务，并不与其为雇主的工作冲突。

Comment: Allen’s preparation for the new business by registering with the regulatory authorities does not conflict with the work for her employer if the preparations have been done on Allen’s own time outside the office and if Allen will not be soliciting clients for the business or otherwise operating the new company until she has left her current employer.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 6：为离职作准备”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。

离职的时间线是关键证据。在职时招揽现有客户或使用雇主资源经营竞争业务，与为未来成立公司作一般准备不同；离职后仍要尊重有效保密和非招揽义务。

推理顺序：判断行为发生在离职前还是离职后，使用的材料属于谁，是否有有效协议，以及是否侵占业务或客户名单。可以保有技能和经验，但不能擅自带走雇主财产或机密。

为什么容易选错：离职后一般可以合法竞争和招揽客户，但受保密、财产和有效限制协议约束。记得客户姓名与复制机密客户数据库的性质不同。

V10-M06-CA-011例 7：与现任雇主竞争
Example 7: Competing with Current Employer

正文案例 / Case · 原版 PDF 页码 / Source PDF pages: 178

题目与资料 / Question and data

例 7：与现任雇主竞争 Example 7: Competing with Current Employer

数名员工计划数周后离职，并一直谨慎避免任何与对现任雇主义务相冲突的活动。

Several employees are planning to depart their current employer in a few weeks and have been careful to not engage in any activities that would conflict with their duty to their current employer.

他们刚得知，雇主的一位客户发出了征求建议书（RFP），以评估并可能聘用新的投资顾问。

They have just learned that one of their employer’s clients has created a request for proposal (RFP) to review and possibly hire a new investment consultant.

RFP 已发给他们的雇主及所有竞争公司。

The RFP has been sent to the employer and all its competitors.

这群员工认为，拟成立的新实体具备回应 RFP 的资格，也有资格争取该业务。

The group believes that the new entity to be formed would be qualified to respond to the RFP and be eligible for the business.

RFP 的提交期限很可能在这些员工正式离职前结束。

The RFP submission period is likely to conclude before the employees’ resignations are effective.

这些准备离职的员工，可以代表其计划成立的新公司回应 RFP 吗？

Is it permissible for the group of departing employees to respond to the RFP for their anticipated new firm?

官方答案与解析 / Official answer and explanation

评析：员工回应雇主也在回应的 RFP，会导致员工与雇主直接竞争。

Comment: A group of employees responding to an RFP that their employer is also responding to would lead to direct competition between the employees and the employer.

除非员工取得雇主许可，可以回应 RFP，否则该行为违反准则 IV(A)。

Such conduct violates Standard IV(A) unless the group of employees receives permission from their employer to respond to the RFP.

补充解析 / Supplementary explanation

本案例“例 7：与现任雇主竞争”应放在准则 IV(A) 的具体要求下判断。

规则如何作用于本题：受雇期间应为雇主合理利益服务，不得利用雇主资源、机密或业务机会为竞争活动获利。离职准备与实际竞争、招揽现有客户之间有重要区别。
